points.title: A が いちばん～ (A ga ichiban～)
points.meaning: Express the superlative degree; 'the most', 'the best', 'the least'.

points.title: A。けれども、～B。(A. Keredomo,~ B.)
points.meaning: Used to express a contrast between two statements. It can be translated as 'but' or 'however'.

points.title: A。しかし、～B。 (A. Shikashi, ~B.)
points.meaning: Expresses contrast or contradiction between two clauses; 'A, but B', 'A, however B'.

points.title: A。じゃ、～B。(A. Ja, ~B.)
points.meaning: Indicates a decision or suggestion; 'well then', 'in that case', 'so'.

points.title: A。それじゃ、～B。(A. Soreja,~B.)
points.meaning: Connect two sentences; 'A, so/in that case, B'

points.title: A。それでは、～B。(A. Soredewa,~B.)
points.meaning: Express a change in situation; 'then', 'in that case', 'so'.

points.title: A。 では、～B。 (A. Dewa, ~B)
points.meaning: Indicates a contrast or comparison between A and B; 'As for A, ~B'.

points.title: A。でも、～B。(A. Demo, ~B)
points.meaning: Used to express contrast between two statements; 'A, but B', 'A, however B'.

points.title: Aと Bと どちら～ (A to B to dochira~)
points.meaning: Used to ask which of two alternatives is preferred or to compare two things

points.title: AとBと どっち〜 (A to B to docchi〜)
points.meaning: Asking which one; 'which', 'A or B'.

points.title: A は B が〜 (A wa B ga〜)
points.meaning: Indicates that there is something unique or different about A and describes what is special about it.

points.title: A は B より～ (A wa B yori～)
points.meaning: Express a comparison between A and B; 'A is more/less than B'.

points.title: A より B のほうが～ (A yori B no hou ga ～)
points.pattern: A より B のほうが～
points.romaji: A yori B no hou ga ～
points.meaning: Used to compare two items; 'B is more ～ than A'.

points.title: い-Adjective く + Verb (i-Adjective + ku + Verb)
points.meaning: Used to connect an い-adjective to a verb, modifying the verb (adverbial usage).

points.title: い-Adjective く します (i-Adjective ku shimasu)
points.meaning: Use an い-adjective to express 'to make' or 'to become'.

points.title: い-Adjective: Negative Polite Form
points.meaning: Change an い-adjective into a polite negative form with ～くないです (or ～くありません).

points.title: い-Adjective て (i-Adjective + te~)
points.meaning: Used to connect two or more い-adjectives to describe something.

points.title: な-Adjective に + Verb
points.meaning: Turn a な-adjective into an adverb by adding に.

points.title: な-Adjective で～ (na-Adjective de~)
points.meaning: Usage of で to connect or add information with a な-adjective.

points.title: な-Adjective に します (na-Adjective ni shimasu)
points.meaning: Expressing a decision or preference with a な-adjective.

points.title: な-Adjective に なります (na-Adjective ni narimasu)
points.pattern: な-Adjective に なります
points.meaning: Express a change or transformation into a state described by the な-adjective.

points.title: Noun か Noun か～ (Noun ka Noun ka～)
points.meaning: Expresses choice or alternatives; 'either', 'or'.

points.title: Noun が できます (Noun ga dekimasu)
points.meaning: Express the ability to do something.

points.title: Noun がほしいです (〜ga hoshii desu)
points.meaning: Express a desire or wanting something; 'I want', 'I would like'.

points.title: Noun から Noun まで (Noun kara Noun made)
points.pattern: Noun から Noun まで
points.meaning: Expresses a range; 'from...to', 'between...and'.

points.title: Noun くらい～ (Noun kurai～)
points.meaning: Express the extent or degree of something; 'about', 'approximately', 'at least'.

points.title: Noun ぐらい～ (Noun gurai～)
points.meaning: Express an approximate amount or degree; 'about', 'approximately'.

points.title: Noun ごろ～ (Noun + goro～)
points.meaning: Expresses 'around' or 'about' a certain time or age.

points.title: Noun だけ〜 (〜dake)
points.meaning: Indicates 'only', 'just', or 'merely'.

points.title: Nounで～ (Noun de ~)
points.meaning: Indicate a place or means for an action or situation; 'at, in, on', 'using', or 'by means of'.

points.title: Noun と～ (Noun to～)
points.meaning: Express 'with', 'and' or 'together with' when connecting nouns.

points.title: Noun に～ (Noun ni～)
points.meaning: Express a specific direction, target or purpose; 'to', 'toward', 'for'.

points.title: Noun に 帰ります (Noun ni kaerimasu)
points.meaning: Express going back or returning to a place: 'to return to', 'to go back to'.

points.title: Noun に します (Noun ni shimasu)
points.meaning: Express a choice or decision; 'choose', 'decide on'.

points.title: Noun に なります (Noun ni narimasu)
points.meaning: Expresses change or becoming something; 'to become', 'to turn into', 'to be'.

points.title: Noun に 来ます (Noun ni kimasu)
points.meaning: Used to express coming to a place.

points.title: Noun に 行きます (Noun ni ikimasu)
points.meaning: Used to express going to a location.

points.title: Noun の あとで (Noun no atode)
points.meaning: Expresses the order of events; 'after', 'later than'.

points.title: Noun の 前に (Noun no mae ni)
points.meaning: Used to describe a location or position 'in front of' a noun.

points.title: Noun は～ (Noun wa〜)
points.meaning: Used to mark the topic of a sentence; 'as for', 'speaking of'.

points.title: Noun も〜 (Noun mo~)
points.meaning: Indicates that the action or state is the same for multiple items or people; 'also', 'as well'.

points.title: Noun や Noun など～ (Noun ya Noun nado)
points.meaning: Lists items or examples but not exhaustively; 'such as', 'like', 'and so on'.

points.title: Noun を〜 (Noun wo〜)
points.meaning: Indicates the direct object of a verb.

points.title: Verb た あとで (ta ato de)
points.meaning: Indicates an action that takes place after another action.

points.title: Verb たいです (taidesu)
points.meaning: Express desire or want to do something; 'I want to', 'I would like to'.

points.title: Verb て～ (Verb + te～)
points.meaning: A verb conjugation that connects actions or states.

points.title: Verb て います (Verb te imasu)
points.meaning: Express ongoing action or state; 'is doing', 'is doing (continuous)', 'has been doing'.

points.title: Verb てから～ (〜te kara)
points.meaning: Express a sequence of actions or events; 'after', 'since', 'once'.

points.title: Verb て ください (Verb-te kudasai)
points.meaning: A request or command; 'please do'.

points.title: Verb ないで ください (〜naide kudasai)
points.pattern: Verb ないで ください
points.meaning: Used to make a polite request for someone not to do something; 'please don't'.

points.title: Noun に 戻ります (Noun ni modorimasu)
points.meaning: Expresses the action of returning to a previous state, place, or condition.

points.title: Verb に 来ます (Verb ni kimasu)
points.meaning: Expresses the purpose of coming to a place; 'come to (do something)'.

points.title: Verb に 行きます (Verb ni ikimasu)
points.meaning: To go (somewhere) in order to do an action.

points.title: Verb ましょう (mashou)
points.meaning: Making a suggestion or invitation; 'let's' or 'shall we'.

points.title: Verb ましょうか。 (〜mashou ka.)
points.meaning: Used to make a polite suggestion or offer help; 'shall we', 'should we', 'do you want me to'.

points.title: Verb ませんか。 (Verb-masenka)
points.meaning: An invitation or suggestion; 'won't you', 'why don't you', 'shall we'.

points.title: Verb ること～ (〜ru koto)
points.meaning: Express an action or event as a noun; 'the act of', 'doing'.

points.title: Verb る こと が できます (ru koto ga dekimasu)
points.pattern: Verb る こと が できます
points.meaning: Express the potential form, or the ability to do something.

points.title: Verb る こと ができる (ru koto ga dekiru)
points.pattern: Verb る こと ができる
points.meaning: Expresses the potential form; 'can', 'be able to', 'is possible'.

points.title: Verb る の～ (Verb + ru + no~)
points.meaning: Used to express the purpose or reason in casual speech, or nominalize the verb with の.

points.title: Verb る 前に (ru mae ni)
points.meaning: Used to express 'before' in a sense of an action must be done before another action or event.

points.title: あまり～ありません (amari ~ arimasen)
points.meaning: Express 'not very', 'not much', or 'not really' when describing a negative state or situation.

points.title: あまり～ないです (amari ~ nai desu)
points.meaning: Express 'not really' or 'not very'; used to soften a negative statement.

points.title: ～あります (〜arimasu)
points.meaning: Indicate possession or existence of inanimate objects; 'there is', 'there are'.

points.title: ～いかがですか。 (〜ikaga desu ka.)
points.meaning: A polite way to ask someone's thoughts, opinions, or preferences; 'how about', 'how is'.

points.title: いくつ～ (ikutsu~)
points.meaning: Used to express 'how many' or ask for the number of something.

points.title: いつか～ (itsuka～)
points.meaning: Indicates an unspecified point in time; 'someday', 'one day', 'at some point'.

points.title: いつでも～ (itsudemo～)
points.meaning: Expresses 'anytime', 'always', or 'whenever'.

points.title: いつも～ (itsumo～)
points.meaning: Expressing 'always' or 'usually' in a sentence.

points.title: ～て います (～te imasu)
points.meaning: Expresses the present continuous or ongoing action; 'to be doing', 'currently doing'.

points.title: ～が (〜ga)
points.meaning: Particle indicating the subject of a sentence or expressing 'but'.

points.title: ～が、～ (〜ga, 〜)
points.meaning: Express a contrast between two sentences; 'but', 'however'.

points.title: ～から、～ (〜kara、～)
points.meaning: Expresses reason or cause; 'because', 'since', 'so'.

points.title: ～からです (〜kara desu)
points.meaning: Express the reason or cause; 'because', 'since', 'due to'.

points.title: ～から もらいます (〜kara moraimasu)
points.meaning: To receive something or get someone to do something.

points.title: ～が 私に くれます (〜ga watashi ni kuremasu)
points.meaning: Used to express that someone gives a gift or favor to 'me'; 'someone gives me'.

points.title: ～けど、～ (〜kedo、～)
points.meaning: Used to connect two clauses; 'but', 'however', 'although'

points.title: ～けれど、～ (〜keredo、～)
points.meaning: Expresses a contrast or contradiction; 'but', 'however', 'even though'.

points.title: こちら～ (kochira～)
points.meaning: Refers to a person, place or thing; 'this', 'this one', 'this way', 'here'.

points.title: さっき～ (sakki～)
points.meaning: Refers to a short time ago or just now.

points.title: すぐに～ (sugu ni～)
points.meaning: Immediately or right away; used to express promptness or quickness.

points.title: ぜんぜん～ (zenzen～)
points.meaning: Used to express 'not at all' or 'completely' in negative sentences.

points.title: そして、～ (soshite、～)
points.meaning: Used to connect two sentences; 'and then', 'and'.

points.title: そちら～ (sochira～)
points.meaning: Indicates a direction or person in moderate distance; 'that way', 'that person'.

points.title: それから、～ (sorekara、～)
points.meaning: Meaning 'after that', 'and then' or 'then', indicating sequence of events.

points.title: だいたい〜 (daitai〜)
points.meaning: Expresses 'roughly', 'approximately', or 'almost'.

points.title: たいてい～ (taitei～)
points.meaning: Used for expressing 'usually', 'mostly', or 'generally'.

points.title: だから、～ (dakara、～)
points.meaning: Expresses a reason or cause; 'because', 'so', 'therefore'.

points.title: ～たり、～たり します (〜tari, 〜tari shimasu)
points.meaning: Used to list multiple actions or states; 'do things like', 'and'.

points.title: だれ～ (dare～)
points.meaning: Asking 'who' in a sentence, used to inquire about someone's identity or to clarify who is being referred to.

points.title: だれか〜 (dareka〜)
points.meaning: Indicates 'someone' or something done or possessed by 'someone'.

points.title: だれでも～ (dare demo～)
points.meaning: Used to express 'anyone' or 'everyone'; 'no matter who'.

points.title: だれも～ないです (dare mo ~ nai desu)
points.meaning: Express 'nobody' or 'no one' in a negative sentence.

points.title: だれも～ません (daremo ~masen)
points.meaning: Express 'nobody' or 'no one' in negative sentences.

points.title: ～どう しますか。 (～dou shimasu ka.)
points.meaning: Asking for someone's opinion or decision; 'what will you do?', 'how will you handle it?'.

points.title: ～どうですか。 (〜dou desu ka.)
points.meaning: Asking for opinions or suggestions; 'how about', 'what do you think of'.

points.title: どうやって～ (douyatte～)
points.meaning: Ask 'how' something is done or how to do something.

points.title: ～どう 言いますか。 (〜dou iimasu ka.)
points.meaning: Asking for the way to say something; 'how do you say'.

points.title: ～とき (〜toki)
points.meaning: Expresses the time when something happens, 'when', 'at the time'.

points.title: ときどき～ (tokidoki～)
points.meaning: Used to indicate the frequency of an event; 'sometimes', 'occasionally', 'now and then'.

points.title: どこ～ (doko～)
points.meaning: Express 'where', used with question words for asking about locations.

points.title: どこか～ (dokoka～)
points.meaning: Expresses 'somewhere', used when the specific location is unknown or uncertain.

points.title: どこでも～ (dokodemo～)
points.meaning: Express 'anywhere' or 'everywhere' in Japanese.

points.title: どこにも + Verb + ないです (doko ni mo + Verb + nai desu)
points.pattern: どこにも + Verb + ないです
points.romaji: doko ni mo + Verb + nai desu
points.meaning: Express that an action cannot be performed anywhere or something cannot be found anywhere.

points.title: どこにも + Verb + ません (doko ni mo + Verb + masen)
points.pattern: どこにも + Verb + ません
points.meaning: Express 'not anywhere' or 'nowhere' with a negative verb.

points.title: どこへも Verb ないです (doko e mo + Verb + nai desu)
points.pattern: どこへも Verb ないです
points.romaji: doko e mo + Verb + nai desu
points.meaning: Express that an action doesn't take place anywhere; 'nowhere', 'not anywhere'.

points.title: どこへも Verb ません (doko e mo + Verb + masen)
points.pattern: どこへも Verb ません
points.meaning: Nowhere; Not to any place

points.title: どこも Verb ないです (dokomo + Verb + naidesu)
points.pattern: どこも Verb ないです
points.meaning: Express that something cannot be found anywhere or in any place; 'nowhere', 'in no place'.

points.title: どこも Verb ません (dokomo + Verb + masen)
points.pattern: どこも Verb ません
points.meaning: Express that 'nowhere' meets the verb action; 'nowhere does/can'.

points.title: どちら～ (dochira～)
points.meaning: Used to ask about two choices or options.

points.title: どなた～ (donata～)
points.meaning: A polite way to ask 'who', used for asking about someone's identity or when seeking information about an unknown person.

points.title: どの Noun (dono Noun)
points.meaning: Expresses 'which'; used to ask about specific items within a group.

points.title: どれでも～ (dore demo～)
points.meaning: Indicates 'any' or 'whichever' when referring to multiple items.

points.title: どんな Noun (donna)
points.meaning: Used to ask or describe 'what kind' or 'what type' of something.

points.title: なに～ (nani~)
points.meaning: Asking about 'what' or 'which' in Japanese

points.title: なにか～ (nanika～)
points.meaning: Indicates 'something' or 'some kind of'.

points.title: なにも～ないです (nani mo~nai desu)
points.meaning: Used to express 'not any' or 'nothing' in a negative sentence.

points.title: なにも～ません (nanimo~masen)
points.meaning: Used to express 'not anything', 'nothing'.

points.title: なん～ (nan~)
points.meaning: Used to form interrogative questions and emphasize the question word for 'what', 'how'.

points.title: なんで～ (nande～)
points.meaning: Asking the reason or cause; 'why', 'how come'.

points.title: なんでも～ (nandemo～)
points.meaning: Means 'any', 'anything', 'anyone'.

points.title: ～なんと 言いますか。 (〜nan to iimasu ka.)
points.meaning: Asking how something is called or referred to; 'how do you say'

points.title: ～に あげます (〜 ni agemasu)
points.meaning: Used to express giving something to someone; 'give', 'offer'.

points.title: ～に もらいます (〜ni moraimasu)
points.meaning: To receive something or some action from someone; 'to get', 'to receive'.

points.title: ～の (〜no)
points.meaning: Express possession, apposition, or description using 'of' or ''s'.

points.title: ～はたいへんです (〜wa taihen desu)
points.meaning: Express that something is difficult or tough.

points.title: ほとんど〜 (hotondo〜)
points.meaning: Used to express 'almost', 'nearly', or 'most'.

points.title: まあまあ～ (maa maa～)
points.meaning: Expresses something as 'so-so', 'not bad', or 'average'.

points.title: まだ〜 (mada〜)
points.meaning: Indicates something has not yet happened or is still happening; 'still', 'not yet'.

points.title: まだ〜ないです (mada 〜 nai desu)
points.meaning: Expresses that something has not happened or been done yet.

points.title: まだ～ません (mada ~masen)
points.meaning: Expresses that something has not happened or been done yet (polite form).

points.title: もう～ (mou～)
points.meaning: Expresses 'already', 'anymore', or 'soon'.

points.title: もうすぐ〜 (mou sugu~)
points.meaning: Express an action or event happening soon: 'soon', 'in a short while', 'almost'.

points.title: もっと〜 (motto〜)
points.meaning: Expresses 'more' or 'even more' when describing a quantity, frequency, or degree.

points.title: よく～ (yoku ~)
points.meaning: Often used to express 'doing something well' or 'often'.

points.title: ～（場所）に～があります (〜basho ni 〜 ga arimasu)
points.meaning: Express the existence or presence of something in a place.

points.title: A とか B とか
points.pattern: A とか B とか
points.meaning: Used to express multiple examples or possibilities; 'such as', 'like', 'for example'.

points.title: A は B ほど～ありません (A wa B hodo ～ arimasen)
points.pattern: A は B ほど～ありません
points.meaning: Express that A is not as much as B; 'not as... as', 'not... to the extent of'.

points.title: A は B ほど～ない (A wa B hodo ~ nai)
points.pattern: A は B ほど～ない
points.meaning: Expressing that A is not as ~ as B; 'not as...as'

points.title: A より B のほうが〜 (A yori B no hou ga 〜)
points.pattern: A より B のほうが〜
points.romaji: A yori B no hou ga 〜
points.meaning: Comparing two things; 'B is more ~ than A'.

points.title: い-Adjective く する/なる (i-Adjective kusuru/naru)
points.pattern: い-Adjective く する/なる
points.meaning: Express a change happening or making something change.

points.title: な-adjective に する/なる
points.pattern: な-adjective に する/なる
points.meaning: Used to indicate change or decision; 'to become' or 'to make' with na-adjectives.

points.title: Noun しか～ない (Noun shika~nai)
points.meaning: Expresses 'only', 'nothing but', or 'no other'.

points.title: Noun に する (Noun ni suru)
points.meaning: Used to indicate a choice or decision, 'to decide on' or 'to choose'.

points.title: Noun に なる (Noun ni naru)
points.meaning: To become; to change into; to turn into.

points.title: のために (no tame ni)
points.meaning: Used to express purpose or reason; 'for', 'for the sake of', 'in order to'.

points.title: Noun の 間に (〜no aida ni)
points.meaning: Expresses 'while' or 'during' a specific period or time.

points.title: Noun ばかり (〜bakari)
points.meaning: Expresses 'only', 'nothing but', 'always', or 'just'.

points.title: Noun を あげる (Noun wo ageru)
points.meaning: To give something to someone; 'give', 'offer', 'present'.

points.title: Nounをいただく (Noun wo itadaku)
points.meaning: To receive or accept something politely; 'to receive', 'to get', 'to accept'.

points.title: Nounをくださる
points.meaning: Used to express someone doing something as a favor or for the benefit of the speaker.

points.title: Noun を くれる (Noun wo kureru)
points.meaning: Expresses that someone gives a thing to the speaker or someone close to the speaker.

points.title: Noun を さしあげる (Noun wo sashiageru)
points.pattern: Noun を さしあげる
points.meaning: A polite way of expressing to give something.

points.title: Noun もらう (Noun wo morau)
points.meaning: To receive or get something from someone; 'to receive', 'to get'.

points.title: Noun + 中 (Noun + ちゅう)
points.meaning: Express 'in the middle of', 'during', or 'in the process of'.

points.title: Verb させられる (Verb-saserareru)
points.meaning: Express the passive causative form; 'to be made to', 'to be forced to'.

points.title: Verb させる (Verb-saseru)
points.meaning: Expresses 'to make someone do something', 'to let someone do something', or 'to cause someone to do something'.

points.title: Verb た ことがある (Verb ta koto ga aru)
points.pattern: Verb た ことがある
points.meaning: Expresses the experience of having done something in the past.

points.title: Verb た ときに (Verb た ときに)
points.meaning: Express an action or event that occurred at a specific time in the past; 'when', 'at the time'.

points.title: Verb た ところ (Verb ta tokoro)
points.meaning: Expresses the situation right after an action has taken place.

points.title: Verb たほうがいい (〜ta hou ga ii)
points.meaning: Used to give advice or make a suggestion to someone - 'it's better if...'.

points.title: Verb ために (tame ni)
points.meaning: Used to describe the purpose or reason for an action; 'for the sake of', 'in order to', 'because of'.

points.title: Verb つもり (〜tsumori)
points.meaning: Express the intention, plan, or determination to do something; 'I intend to', 'I plan to', 'I'm determined to'.

points.title: Verb てあげる (Verb te ageru)
points.meaning: Used to express doing something for someone; 'do something for someone'.

points.title: Verb て ある (Verb-te aru)
points.meaning: Indicates that an action has been done and its result is still in effect.

points.title: Verb て いく (Verb-te iku)
points.meaning: Expresses an action that continues on into the future or a change that progresses over time.

points.title: Verb ていただきたい (te itadakitai)
points.meaning: Express a polite request or desire that someone does something for you.

points.title: Verb ていただく (〜te itadaku)
points.meaning: Used to express receiving someone's favor or help; 'to kindly do'.

points.title: Verb て いただけませんか (Verb te itadakemasen ka)
points.pattern: Verb て いただけませんか
points.meaning: A polite request; 'Could you please...', 'Would you mind...'

points.title: Verb て いる (Verb-te iru)
points.meaning: Expresses an ongoing action or a state resulting from a past action.

points.title: Verb て いる ところ (Verb te iru tokoro)
points.pattern: Verb て いる ところ
points.meaning: Describes an action that is currently happening; 'in the middle of', 'in the process of'.

points.title: Verb ている間に (te iru aida ni)
points.meaning: Expresses 'while' or 'during the time' something is happening.

points.title: Verb ておく (〜te oku)
points.meaning: Perform an action in preparation for a future situation; 'to do something in advance'.

points.title: Verb て くださいませんか (Verb-te kudasaimasen ka)
points.pattern: Verb て くださいませんか
points.meaning: Polite request for asking someone for a favor.

points.title: Verb て くださる (Verb-te kudasaru)
points.meaning: Expresses gratitude for receiving someone's favor; 'to kindly do'.

points.title: Verb て くる (Verb te kuru)
points.meaning: An action that starts in the past and continues to the present or future; 'come to', 'begin to', 'become'.

points.title: Verb てくれませんか (〜te kuremasen ka)
points.meaning: A polite way to request someone to do something for you; 'Could you please', 'Would you please', 'Won't you'.

points.title: Verb て くれる (Verb-te kureru)
points.meaning: Expresses that someone does something for the speaker (or another person in speaker's group); 'to do something for me/us'.

points.title: Verb て + さしあげる (Verb TE sashiageru)
points.pattern: Verb て + さしあげる
points.meaning: A polite way to express giving or doing something for someone.

points.title: Verb てしまう (〜te shimau)
points.meaning: Expresses unintentional actions or actions with regrettable outcomes; 'to end up doing', 'to accidentally do'.

points.title: Verb て ほしい (Verb-te hoshii)
points.meaning: Express a desire for someone else to do something; 'I want (someone) to'.

points.title: Verb てみる (〜te miru)
points.meaning: Used to express 'try to' or 'attempt to do'.

points.title: Verb てもらいたい (～te moraitai)
points.meaning: Express a desire to receive a favor or service from someone else.

points.title: Verb て もらう (Verb-te morau)
points.meaning: Express receiving a favor or action from someone.

points.title: Verb てもらえませんか (～te moraemasen ka)
points.pattern: Verb てもらえませんか
points.meaning: A polite way to ask for a favor or request someone to do something.

points.title: Verb ない ことがある (Verb-nai koto ga aru)
points.pattern: Verb ない ことがある
points.meaning: Expresses that something doesn't always happen or there are occasions when it doesn't happen.

points.title: Verb ない + ことにする (Verb nai koto ni suru)
points.pattern: Verb ない + ことにする
points.meaning: To decide not to do something.

points.title: Verb ない ことになる (Verb nai koto ni naru)
points.pattern: Verb ない ことになる
points.meaning: Expresses a result; 'end up not', 'it will become that', 'it would mean that'.

points.title: Verb ないほうがいい (Verb nai hou ga ii)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea that it is better not to do something.

points.title: Verb ながら (〜nagara)
points.meaning: Expresses 'while' or 'as' in the sense of doing two things simultaneously.

points.title: Verb なさい (〜nasai)
points.meaning: A command form used to give orders or instructions; 'Please do', 'Do this'.

points.title: Verb にくい (〜nikui)
points.meaning: Express difficulty or complexity; 'hard to', 'difficult to', 'not easily'.

points.title: Verb やすい (〜yasui)
points.meaning: Indicates that something is easy to do; 'easy to', 'easy for'.

points.title: Verb ようと思う (Verb-you to omou)
points.meaning: Express intention or plan to do something; 'I think I will', 'I plan to', 'I intend to'.

points.title: Verb ように (〜you ni)
points.meaning: Used to express 'like', 'as if', 'in order to', or 'so that'.

points.title: Verb ようにする (Verb ~you ni suru)
points.meaning: Make an effort to; try to; see to it that; ensure that.

points.title: Verb ようになる (〜you ni naru)
points.meaning: Express a change in ability, situation or state; 'become able to', 'come to', 'begin to'.

points.title: Verb ように言う (Verb-you ni iu)
points.meaning: Tell someone to do something; 'tell to do', 'instruct to do'.

points.title: Verb られる (〜rareru)
points.meaning: Expresses passive voice or potential form for verbs.

points.title: Verb る ことがある (〜ru koto ga aru)
points.pattern: Verb る ことがある
points.meaning: Used to express that something happens sometimes or has happened before.

points.title: Verb ることができる (〜ru koto ga dekiru)
points.meaning: Express ability or possibility of doing an action; 'can', 'be able to', 'is possible'.

points.title: Verb ることにする (〜ru koto ni suru)
points.meaning: Decide to do something, make a decision.

points.title: Verb る ことになる (〜ru koto ni naru)
points.pattern: Verb る ことになる
points.meaning: Indicates that something has been decided or arranged; 'it has been decided that', 'it turns out that'.

points.title: Verb るときに (〜ru toki ni)
points.meaning: Describes the time when a certain action takes place; 'when', 'at the time'.

points.title: Verb る ところ (Verb-ru tokoro)
points.meaning: Expresses the state or moment when an action is about to happen or is happening.

points.title: Verb 出す (~dasu)
points.meaning: Express the action of taking something out, starting an action, or emphasizing a verb.

points.title: Verb 方 (〜hou)
points.meaning: Indicates the way or method of doing something; often read as '～かた' ('how to', 'the way of').

points.title: Verb 終わる (〜owaru)
points.meaning: Verbal action is completed; 'to finish', 'to end'.

points.title: Verb + 続ける (つづける, tsuzukeru)
points.meaning: To continue doing or to keep doing an action.

points.title: ～かどうか (〜ka dou ka)

points.title: ～かなあ (〜kanaa)

points.title: ～かもしれない (〜kamoshirenai)

points.title: ～から (〜kara)

points.title: ～けれど (〜keredo)
points.meaning: Indicate a soft contrast or contradiction; 'but', 'however'.

points.title: ～させてください (〜sasete kudasai)
points.meaning: Express a polite request to allow or permit someone to do something.

points.title: ～し、～し、～ (〜shi, 〜shi, 〜)
points.meaning: Express multiple reasons or characteristics; 'and', 'because', 'since'.

points.title: ～すぎる (〜sugiru)
points.meaning: Expresses that something is excessive or overdone; 'too much', 'too', 'over'.

points.title: ～ずつ (〜zutsu)
points.meaning: Indicates equal distribution; 'each', 'per', 'apiece'.

points.title: ～そうだ (〜sou da)
points.meaning: Express the appearance, seeming, or feeling of something; 'looks like', 'seems', 'appears'.

points.title: そんな (sonna) + Noun
points.meaning: Expresses 'that kind/type of'; referring to something near the listener or previously mentioned.

points.title: そんなに～ (sonna ni〜)
points.meaning: Expresses 'not so much', 'not that', or 'not so ~'.

points.title: ～たらいい (〜tara ii)
points.meaning: Expressing a desire or suggestion for a particular outcome; 'it would be good if', 'should', 'I hope'.

points.title: ～たら いかがですか (〜tara ikaga desu ka)
points.meaning: Making polite suggestions; 'how about if', 'what if', 'it would be good if'.

points.title: ～たら どうですか (〜tara doudesuka)
points.meaning: Express a suggestion or advice; 'what if', 'how about', 'why don't you'.

points.title: ～たり～たり (〜tari 〜tari)
points.meaning: Used to list multiple actions or states; 'doing things like', 'and so on', 'etc.'

points.title: ～だろう (〜darou)

points.title: ～っていう (〜tte iu)
points.meaning: Used to quote, define, or specify a noun.

points.title: ～で (〜de)

points.title: ～でしょう (〜deshou)
points.meaning: A conjecture or probability; 'probably', 'I think', 'it seems'.

points.title: ～てはいけない (〜te wa ikenai)
points.meaning: Expresses prohibition; 'must not', 'cannot'.

points.title: ～てもいい (〜temo ii)
points.meaning: To give or ask permission; 'it's okay to', 'may', 'can'.

points.title: ～ても/でも (〜te mo/demo)
points.meaning: Expresses 'even if' or 'even though'; used to convey contradiction or contrast.

points.title: ～といい (〜to ii)

points.title: ～という (〜to iu) Noun

points.title: どういう Noun (dou iu Noun)

points.title: ～と思う (〜to omou)
points.meaning: Express one's thoughts or opinions; 'I think', 'I believe'.

points.title: ～という (〜to iu)

points.title: ～ないといけない (〜nai to ikenai)

points.meaning: Express a necessity or obligation; 'must', 'have to'.

points.meaning: Express the obligation to do something; 'have to', 'must', 'need to'.

points.title: ～なくてはいけない (〜nakute wa ikenai)
points.meaning: Expresses the necessity or obligation; 'must', 'have to'.

points.title: ～なくてもいい (〜nakutemo ii)

points.meaning: Express obligation or necessity; 'must', 'have to', 'need to'.

points.meaning: Express a reason or a cause for something; 'because', 'since', 'so'.

points.title: ～のに (〜no ni)

points.title: ～ばいい (〜ba ii)
points.meaning: Express a suggestion or advice; 'should', 'it would be good if'.

points.title: ～まで (〜made)
points.meaning: Indicates extent, 'until', 'up to', 'as far as', 'even'.

points.title: ～までに (〜made ni)
points.meaning: Express 'by' or 'before' a certain time or action.

points.title: ～まま (〜mama)
points.meaning: Express 'as it is', 'while' or 'unchanged state'.

points.title: ～みたいだ (〜mitai da)
points.meaning: Indicates similarity, resemblance or 'like'; 'it seems', 'appears', 'looks like'.

points.title: ～も (〜mo)
points.meaning: Indicates 'also', 'too', or 'as well'.

points.title: ～ようだ (〜you da)
points.meaning: Expresses appearance, similarity or inference; 'it seems', 'it looks like', 'it appears'.

points.title: ～んです (〜n desu)
points.meaning: Provide an explanation or reason; 'it is that', 'the thing is', 'the reason is'.

points.title: 文A。そのうえ 文B。
points.meaning: Shows additional information; 'furthermore', 'besides', 'in addition'.

points.title: 文A。それで 文B (Bun A. Sorede Bun B)
points.meaning: Used to connect two sentences; 'So', 'That's why', 'Therefore'.

points.title: 文A。それに 文B (Bun A. Soreni Bun B)
points.meaning: Express 'in addition to; besides,' used to include additional information.

points.title: 文A。だから 文B (Bun A. Dakara Bun B)
points.meaning: Express reason or cause; 'because', 'so', 'therefore'.

points.meaning: Used to express 'in addition to', 'besides', or 'furthermore' when adding information or making a suggestion.

points.title: ～うちに (〜uchi ni)
points.meaning: Express 'while', 'before', or 'during' a certain condition or situation.

points.title: ～うとした (〜uto shita)
points.meaning: Express an action someone tried to do but couldn't; 'tried to', 'attempted to'.

points.title: ～おかげで (〜okagede)
points.meaning: Expresses gratitude or shows a positive result due to a certain factor; 'thanks to', 'because of'.

points.title: ～かけ (〜kake)
points.meaning: Expresses the meaning of being in the middle of doing something or of something being partway done.

points.title: ～かなあ (〜kanaa)
points.meaning: Expressing uncertainty or a mild wish; 'I wonder', 'maybe'.

points.title: ～ないで (〜naide)
points.meaning: Express 'without doing ~' or 'without ~ing'.

points.title: ～から～にかけて (〜kara 〜ni kakete)
points.meaning: Expresses a range of something, such as time or space; 'from...to', 'between'.

points.title: ～かわりに (〜kawari ni)
points.meaning: In place of; instead of; as a substitute for.

points.title: ～きり (〜kiri)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of 'only', 'since', or 'after'.

points.title: ～くせに (〜kuse ni)
points.meaning: Used to express criticism or disapproval; 'even though', 'despite', 'in spite of'.

points.title: ～くらい (〜kurai)
points.meaning: Expresses an approximate quantity or degree; 'about', 'approximately', or 'to the extent of'.

points.title: ～くらい～は～ない (〜kurai 〜wa 〜nai)
points.meaning: Express the least one can do; 'at least', 'the least', 'no less than'.

points.title: ～こそ (〜koso)
points.meaning: Emphasizes the importance or uniqueness of something or someone; 'precisely', 'exactly', 'it is...', 'of all...'.

points.title: ～こと (〜koto)
points.meaning: Express an action in a nominal (noun-like) form or state fact or experience.

points.title: ～ことだ (〜koto da)
points.meaning: Expresses advice or recommendation; 'should', 'it is important', 'it is necessary'.

points.title: ～ことにしている (〜koto ni shite iru)
points.meaning: Express a personal rule or habit; 'I make it a rule to', 'I always make sure to'.

points.title: ～ことになっている (〜koto ni natte iru)
points.meaning: Describes something that is decided, arranged, or expected.

points.title: ～ことは…が (～koto wa... ga)
points.meaning: Indicates that while something may be true or valid, there is another contrasting point.

points.title: ～ことはない (〜koto wa nai)
points.meaning: Expresses that something doesn't need to be done or there's no occasion to do it; 'don't have to', 'not necessary'.

points.title: ～さ (〜sa)
points.meaning: Express the degree or extent of a quality; '-ness', 'degree of'.

points.title: ～さえ (～sae)
points.meaning: Emphasizes a specific item or action; 'even', 'if only', 'as long as'.

points.title: ～しかない (〜shika nai)
points.meaning: Express the idea of 'only', 'no other option but', 'nothing else but'.

points.title: すこしも〜ない (sukoshimo~nai)
points.meaning: Express a negative state or action; 'not at all', 'none whatsoever'.

points.title: ～ずに (〜zu ni)
points.meaning: Express 'without doing' something or 'not doing' something.

points.title: ～せいで (〜sei de)
points.meaning: Indicates that something or someone caused an unfortunate result.

points.title: ～せてください (〜sete kudasai)
points.meaning: Requesting someone to allow or let you do something (causative request).

points.title: ～そのために (〜sono tame ni)
points.meaning: For the purpose of; because of; in order to.

points.title: ～その結果 (〜sono kekka)
points.meaning: Shows the result or consequence of a previous action or situation; 'as a result', 'in consequence'.

points.title: ～それと～ (〜sore to〜)
points.meaning: Used to link two or more items; 'and', 'also'.

points.title: ～？それとも～？ (～? sore tomo ～?)
points.meaning: Presents two alternatives or choices; 'or', 'either...or'.

points.title: ～だけしか (～dake shika)
points.meaning: Emphasizes the scarcity or insufficiency of something; 'only', 'nothing but'.

points.title: だけど (dakedo)
points.meaning: Expresses a contrast or contradiction; 'but', 'however', 'even though'.

points.title: ～たて (～tate)
points.meaning: Indicates an action that has just been completed; 'freshly', 'just'.

points.title: ～たとえ～ても (〜tatoe〜temo)
points.meaning: Express a condition with 'even if'; 'no matter how'.

points.title: ～たところ (〜ta tokoro)
points.meaning: Expresses the result or outcome of an action; 'after', 'just when', 'upon'.

points.title: ～たとたん (〜ta totan)
points.meaning: Express the moment something happens; 'as soon as', 'the moment', 'the instant'.

points.title: ～たびに (〜tabi ni)
points.meaning: Express 'every time' or 'whenever'.

points.title: ～だものだ (〜da mono da)
points.meaning: Express the reason or cause, often used to justify something.

points.title: ～ちゃった (〜chatta)
points.meaning: Express an unintentional action or a regretful action; 'ended up doing', 'did accidentally'.

points.title: ～ついでに (〜tsuide ni)
points.meaning: Do something while or after completing another action; 'while', 'by the way'.

points.title: ～っけ？ (〜kke?)
points.meaning: Used to express that one is trying to recall some information.

points.title: ～っぱい (〜ppai)
points.meaning: Expresses fullness or completeness; 'full', 'full of', 'filled with'.

points.title: ～っぱなし (〜ppanashi)
points.meaning: Indicate a state where an action is left as is (unchanged or unfinished).

points.title: ～つまり (〜tsumari)
points.meaning: Summarizing, restating, or clarifying a point: 'in other words', 'that is to say'.

points.title: ～つもりでした (〜tsumori deshita)
points.meaning: Expressing a past intention or plan; 'was planning to', 'meant to'.

points.title: ～てくれと (〜te kureto)
points.meaning: Quote someone's request (telling someone to do something).

points.title: ～てごらん (〜te goran)
points.meaning: Suggest or invite someone to try doing something; 'Why don't you try...'.

points.title: ですから～ (desu kara)
points.meaning: Expresses reason or cause; 'because', 'since', 'so'.

points.title: ～てはじめて (〜te hajimete)

points.title: ～てほしい (〜te hoshii)
points.meaning: Express a desire for someone else to do something; 'I want you to do...'.

points.title: ～ても (〜temo)

points.title: ～といいなあ (〜to ii naa)
points.meaning: Express a wish or hope; 'it would be nice if', 'I hope that'.

points.title: ～ということだ (〜to iu koto da)
points.meaning: Express a conclusion or hearsay; 'I heard', 'it means', 'it can be said'.

points.title: ～というと (〜to iu to)
points.meaning: Used to provide an example or characteristic related to the topic; 'when it comes to', 'speaking of'.

points.title: ～というの～ (〜to iu no〜)
points.meaning: Explain or emphasize the reason for a situation or action.

points.title: ～というのは (〜to iu no wa)
points.meaning: Used to provide an explanation or definition; 'that is to say...', 'by that, I mean...'.

points.title: ～というより (〜to iu yori)
points.meaning: Express a comparison with preference; 'rather than', 'more like', 'instead of'.

points.title: ～といっても (〜to ittemo)
points.meaning: Express the meaning 'even though', 'although', 'but'.

points.title: ～とおり (〜toori)

points.title: ～とく (〜toku)

points.title: ～ところが (〜tokoro ga)

points.title: ～ところだった (〜tokoro datta)
points.meaning: Expresses a near miss or a situation that almost happened; 'was just about to', 'almost', 'nearly'.

points.title: ところで (tokorode)
points.meaning: Used for changing the topic or bringing up a new topic; 'by the way', 'speaking of'.

points.title: ～としたら (〜to shitara)

points.title: ～として (〜to shite)

points.title: どんなに～ても (donna ni ~ temo)
points.meaning: Expresses 'no matter how much' or 'even if'; emphasizes the degree of a situation.

points.title: ～ないことはない (〜nai koto wa nai)

points.title: ～ないと (〜nai to)

points.title: ～なぜなら (〜nazenara)

points.title: ～に関して (〜ni kanshite)
