points.title: ～まで (〜made)
points.meaning: Express 'until', 'up to', or 'as far as' to indicate the end point of an action or range.

points.title: ～まま (〜mama)
points.meaning: Expresses the state or condition remaining unchanged.

points.title: まるで～よう (maru de ~ you)
points.meaning: Used to express a strong resemblance or similarity; 'as if', 'just like', 'as though'.

points.title: ～てみる (〜te miru)
points.meaning: A grammar structure used to express the action of trying or attempting something to see what happens.

points.title: ～みたいだ (〜mitai da)
points.meaning: Express similarity or appearance; 'like', 'seems', 'looks'.

points.title: ～めったに～ない (〜metta ni 〜nai)
points.meaning: Used to express that something rarely, hardly ever or seldom happens.

points.title: ～めったにない (〜metta ni nai)
points.meaning: Expresses the rarity of an action, event or state; 'hardly', 'rarely', 'seldom'.

points.title: もしかすると〜かもしれない (moshikasuru to 〜kamoshirenai)
points.pattern: もしかすると〜かもしれない
points.meaning: Express the possibility of something; 'maybe', 'perhaps', 'might'.

points.title: もし～たなら (moshi ~ tanara)
points.meaning: Express a hypothetical condition, 'if' or 'in case'.

points.title: もし～ても (moshi ~ temo)
points.meaning: Express a hypothetical situation or assumption with the nuance of 'even if'.

points.title: もしも～なら (moshimo ~ nara)
points.meaning: Express a hypothetical condition or situation; 'if', 'in case', 'suppose'.

points.title: ～ようとしない (〜you to shinai)
points.meaning: Not showing any sign or intention to do something.

points.title: ～ようと思う (〜you to omou)
points.meaning: Expresses the speaker's intention or plan to do something.

points.title: ～ように (〜you ni)
points.meaning: Expressing a purpose, a goal or a way of doing something; 'in order to', 'so that', 'like', 'as'

points.title: ～ように (〜you ni)
points.meaning: Used to express a purpose, a way, or a natural tendency.

points.title: ～ように (〜you ni)
points.meaning: Used to express purpose or how something is done; 'like', 'as if', 'in order to'.

points.title: ～ようにしましょう (〜you ni shimashou)
points.meaning: A suggestion to make an effort or try to do something; 'let's try to', 'let's make sure to'.

points.title: ～ようになった (〜you ni natta)
points.meaning: Express an event or state that became possible; 'became able to', 'started to', 'now can'.

points.title: ～ように言う (〜you ni iu)
points.meaning: To convey a message, instruction or request to someone; 'to tell (someone) to', 'to say to (someone)'.

points.title: ～らしい (〜rashii)
points.meaning: Expresses hearsay; 'I heard', 'it seems', 'apparently'.

points.title: ～られた (〜rareta)
points.meaning: Express a passive action, 'was/were', 'has/have been'.

points.title: ～ている (〜te iru)
points.meaning: Expresses a continuing action or a resulting state; 'is ~ing', 'has been', 'has'.

points.title: ～わけがない (〜wake ga nai)
points.meaning: Expresses that something is impossible or unreasonable; 'there's no way', 'can't be'.

points.title: ～わけだ (〜wake da)
points.meaning: Expresses a logical conclusion or reason based on information; 'that's why', 'no wonder', 'it means'.

points.title: ～わけではない (〜wake dewa nai)
points.meaning: Denies a general assumption; 'it does not mean that', 'it's not the case'.

points.title: ～わけにはいかない (〜wake ni wa ikanai)
points.meaning: Expresses that something cannot be allowed or permitted due to social/moral obligations.

points.title: ～わりには (〜wari ni wa)
points.meaning: Expresses contrast between expectation and reality; 'despite', 'considering', 'even though'.

points.title: ～んだって (〜n datte)
points.meaning: Conveys information heard from someone else; 'I heard', 'They said'.

points.title: ～んだもん (〜nda mon)
points.meaning: Used to convey a sense of justification; 'because', 'that's why', 'it's just that'.

points.title: ～上げる (〜ageru)
points.meaning: Indicates to finish doing something completely.

points.title: ～切れない (～kirenai)
points.meaning: Expresses inability to completely finish or do something.

points.title: 必ずしも～とは限らない (kanarazushimo ～ towa kagiranai)
points.pattern: 必ずしも～とは限らない
points.meaning: Not necessarily; not always.

points.title: ～最中に (～saichuu ni)
points.meaning: In the middle of / while doing something.

points.title: 決して～ない (kesshite ~ nai)
points.meaning: Express 'never', 'by no means', or 'not at all' when negating a statement.

points.title: A あるいは B (A aruiwa B)
points.meaning: Indicates alternatives; 'A or B', 'either A or B'.

points.title: A。おまけに B。(~omake ni)
points.meaning: Expresses that in addition to A, there is also B; 'moreover', 'besides', 'not only', 'but also'.

points.title: A。さて B。(A. Sate B.)
points.meaning: Indicates a sudden change or shift in the topic or situation; 'now then', 'well', 'so'.

points.title: A。しかも B。(A. Shikamo B.)
points.meaning: Expressing additional information; 'moreover', 'besides', 'furthermore'.

points.title: A。したがって B。(A. Shitagatte B.)
points.meaning: Express a cause-and-effect relationship; 'therefore', 'consequently', 'so'.

points.title: A すなわち B。 (A sunawachi B)
points.meaning: Express that A is equivalent to B; 'in other words', 'namely', 'that is to say'.

points.title: A。すると B。(~suruto)
points.meaning: Indicates that when action A is done, action or event B follows; 'then', 'when', 'if'.

points.title: A。そういえば B。(~souieba)
points.meaning: Recalling something related to A; 'speaking of which', 'by the way', 'now that you mention it'.

points.title: A。そこで B。(~sokode)
points.meaning: Expresses 'therefore' or 'because of that'.

points.title: A。それがB。(~sorega)
points.meaning: Expressing 'that's exactly what A is; in other words, B'.

points.title: A。それで B。 (~sore de)
points.meaning: Express a sequence of events or cause-and-effect; 'and then', 'so', 'because of that'.

points.title: A。それでも B。(~sore demo)
points.meaning: Expresses 'even so', 'nevertheless', 'still', or 'but'; used to contrast two statements.

points.title: A。それなのに B。(~sorenanoni)
points.meaning: Express contrast or a contradiction between two situations or facts; 'even though', 'despite', 'but still'.

points.title: A。それなら B。(A. Sore nara B.)
points.meaning: Express 'if that's the case, then'; used to show a logical consequence or decision based on a given situation.

points.title: A それはそうと B。 (A Sore wa sou to B)
points.pattern: A それはそうと B。
points.romaji: A Sore wa sou to B
points.meaning: Changing the topic; 'by the way', 'speaking of which'.

points.title: A。だが B。(~daga)
points.meaning: Expresses contrasting ideas or statements; 'but', 'however'.

points.title: A。ただB。(~tada)
points.meaning: Express contrast between two situations; 'although', 'but', 'however'.

points.title: A。ただしB。 (A. Tadashi B)
points.meaning: Adding a condition or exception to a statement; 'however', 'provided that', 'but only if'.

points.title: A。だって B。(Datte~)
points.meaning: Used to give a reason, express cause or bring up a topic; 'because', 'since', 'it's just that'.

points.title: A。ちなみに B。(A. Chinamini B.)
points.meaning: Used to give additional information about the topic; 'by the way', 'incidentally'.

points.title: A。ということは B。 (A. To iu koto wa B.)
points.romaji: A. To iu koto wa B.
points.meaning: Expresses the meaning 'if A, that means B' or 'A implies B'.

points.title: A。というのは B。(Toiu no wa~)
points.meaning: Used to give an explanation or provide additional information for A; 'that is to say', 'in other words'.

points.title: A。なおB。(A. Nao B.)
points.meaning: Provides additional information; 'moreover', 'besides', 'in addition'.

points.title: A。もっとも B。(Motto mo ~)
points.meaning: Express contrasting opinions or facts; 'although', 'but', 'however'.

points.title: A。要するに B。(A. Yousuru ni B.)
points.meaning: Expressing 'in short', 'in a nutshell', or 'to sum up' when restating or summarizing A as B.

points.title: Noun につき (〜ni tsuki)
points.meaning: Indicates the reason, cause, or condition for something; 'due to', 'regarding', 'per'.

points.title: Noun にて (Noun nite)
points.meaning: Expresses location or means; 'at', 'in', 'by', 'with'.

points.title: Noun の ことだから (Noun no koto dakara)
points.pattern: Noun の ことだから
points.meaning: Used to provide a reason or explanation based on one's knowledge about the noun; 'since', 'because', 'knowing'.

points.title: Noun を はじめ (Noun wo hajime)
points.meaning: Meaning 'starting with', 'including', 'not only... but also'.

points.title: Noun を はじめとして (Noun wo hajime to shite)
points.pattern: Noun を はじめとして
points.meaning: Expresses 'starting with', 'beginning with', or 'including'.

points.title: Noun を はじめとする Noun (Noun o hajime to suru Noun)
points.pattern: Noun を はじめとする Noun
points.romaji: Noun o hajime to suru Noun
points.meaning: Indicates a representative example of a group; 'starting with', 'including', 'such as'.

points.title: Noun を めぐって (Noun wo megutte)
points.meaning: Concerning; with regard to; about

points.title: Noun を めぐる Noun (Noun o meguru Noun)
points.pattern: Noun を めぐる Noun
points.meaning: Indicate a situation or event revolving around a particular noun; 'concerning', 'regarding', 'pertaining to'.

points.title: Noun を もとに (Noun o moto ni)
points.meaning: Based on; drawing from; using as a reference.

points.title: Noun を もとにして (Noun wo moto ni shite)
points.pattern: Noun を もとにして
points.meaning: Based on; using; utilizing.

points.title: Verb ことなく (~kotonaku)
points.meaning: Means 'without doing', 'not doing', or 'without happening'.

points.title: Verb ないことには Verb ない (~nai koto ni wa ~ nai)
points.pattern: Verb ないことには Verb ない
points.meaning: Express that something cannot be done without meeting a certain condition.

points.title: ～あげく (~ageku)
points.meaning: Expresses the outcome of a series of actions or events; 'in the end', 'finally', 'after'.

points.title: ～あまり (〜amari)
points.meaning: Expresses the result of doing something excessively or beyond a certain point.

points.title: ～うちに (〜uchi ni)
points.meaning: Expresses doing something while a certain condition still holds; 'while', 'before', 'as long as'.

points.title: ～がい (〜gai)
points.meaning: Expresses 'worth doing' for verbs.

points.title: ～かいがあって (〜kaiga atte)
points.meaning: Used to express that an effort is worth it or has value; 'to be worth the effort' or 'to pay off'.

points.title: ～かいもなく (〜kai mo naku)
points.meaning: Expresses the meaning of 'without worth', 'in vain', 'fruitless'.

points.title: ～かける (〜kakeru)
points.meaning: Indicates a process or action is 'in progress' or 'halfway'.

points.title: ～がち (〜gachi)
points.meaning: Expresses that something tends to occur frequently or habitually.

points.title: ～か～ないかのうちに (〜ka〜naika no uchi ni)
points.meaning: Expresses an action that occurs immediately after another action; 'as soon as', 'no sooner than', 'the moment'.

points.title: ～かねない (〜kane nai)
points.meaning: Express the likelihood of a negative outcome or consequence.

points.title: ～かねる (〜kaneru)
points.meaning: Express inability or impossibility of doing an action (often as a polite refusal).

points.title: ～かのようだ (〜ka no you da)
points.meaning: Express a similarity or comparison; 'as if', 'like', 'as though'.

points.title: ～か～まいか (〜ka 〜maika)
points.meaning: Used to express a dilemma or indecision between two options or actions.

points.title: ～からこそ (〜kara koso)
points.meaning: Express the emphasis on the reason; 'precisely because', 'it is precisely because'.

points.title: 〜からして (〜kara shite)
points.meaning: Expresses that something is exceptional, unusual, or negative based on a particular aspect or point.

points.title: ～からすると (〜kara suru to)
points.meaning: Expresses a judgment or evaluation based on a certain standard; 'from this perspective', 'considering', 'judging from'.

points.title: ～からといって (〜kara to itte)
points.meaning: Expresses 'just because...doesn't mean' or 'even though...not necessarily'.

points.title: ～から～にかけて (〜kara 〜ni kakete)
points.meaning: Expresses a range of time, space, or quantities; 'from...to', 'between...and', 'over'.

points.title: ～からには (〜kara niwa)
points.meaning: Express a sense of responsibility or determination; 'since', 'now that', 'if'.

points.title: ～から見ると (〜kara miru to)
points.meaning: Express a perspective or point of view; 'from the standpoint of', 'in terms of', 'from the perspective of'.

points.title: ～から言うと (〜kara iuto)
points.meaning: Express a judgment or opinion based on a specific criterion; 'speaking from', 'in terms of', 'from the viewpoint of'.

points.title: ～くせに (〜kuse ni)
points.meaning: Used to criticize someone for doing something contrary to what one would expect from their nature or situation.

points.title: ～ことから (〜koto kara)
points.meaning: Indicates the reason or basis for something; 'because', 'since', 'due to'.

points.title: ～ことに (〜koto ni)
points.meaning: Used to express feelings or emotions about a situation, action, or outcome.

points.title: ～ことになっている (〜koto ni natte iru)
points.meaning: Expresses that something is supposed to be or has been decided (rule, plan, custom).

points.title: ～さえ～ば (〜sae ~ba)
points.meaning: Expresses that, as long as a certain condition is met, something else will follow; 'if only', 'provided that'.

points.title: ～ざるを得ない (〜zaru wo enai)
points.meaning: Have no choice but to; cannot help but.

points.title: ～ずにはいられない (〜zu ni wa irarenai)
points.meaning: Cannot help but; cannot resist doing; an irresistible urge.

points.title: ～そうにない (〜sou ni nai)
points.meaning: Express the unlikelihood of something happening; 'not likely', 'doesn't seem'.

points.title: ～たかと思ったら (〜ta ka to omottara)
points.meaning: Express a sequence of events happening in quick succession; 'as soon as', 'no sooner than'.

points.title: ～たきり (〜takiri)
points.meaning: Express 'since then' or 'after'; used to indicate that an action occurred once and has not been repeated or that a state has continued since a certain event or time.

points.title: ～だけあって (〜dake atte)
points.meaning: Expresses that something is as expected or deserves its reputation.

points.title: ～だけましだ (〜dake mashi da)
points.meaning: Expresses that although the situation isn’t ideal, it could be worse; 'it’s not great, but at least...'.

points.title: ～たところ (〜ta tokoro)
points.meaning: Used to describe an action that has just been completed, often followed by a result or observation.

points.title: ～たとたん (〜ta totan)
points.meaning: Express the moment something happens; 'as soon as', 'just when'.

points.title: ～だらけ (〜darake)
points.meaning: Indicates that something is full of or covered with a certain (usually negative) characteristic.

points.title: ～っこない (〜kkonai)
points.meaning: Expresses the impossibility or very low probability of something happening; 'no way', 'impossible'.

points.title: ～つつ (〜tsutsu)
points.meaning: Shows two actions happening simultaneously or a contrast; 'while', 'although'.

points.title: ～つつある (〜tsutsu aru)
points.meaning: Expresses an ongoing process or gradual change.

points.title: ～っぱなし (〜ppanashi)
points.meaning: Express a continuous action or state; 'left as is', 'non-stop'.

points.title: ～っぽい (〜ppoi)
points.meaning: Indicates that something has the appearance, characteristics, or behavior of something else.

points.title: ～ていられない (〜te irarenai)
points.meaning: Expresses that one cannot afford to do something; 'can't keep on', 'unable to continue'.

points.title: ～てかなわない (〜te kanawanai)
points.meaning: Expresses that something cannot be endured, tolerated, or is unbearable.

points.title: ～てからでないと (〜te kara denai to)
points.meaning: Indicates that something cannot be done before a certain action is completed; 'not until', 'only after'.

points.title: ～てこそ (〜te koso)
points.meaning: Emphasizes the condition; 'only when', 'precisely because'.

points.title: ～でしょうがない (〜deshou ga nai)
points.meaning: Expresses an intense emotional or physical state; 'extremely', 'can’t help but'.

points.title: ～でたまらない (〜de tamaranai)
points.meaning: Express extremely strong feelings or sensations; 'can't stand', 'unbearably'.

points.title: ～でならない (〜de naranai)
points.meaning: Indicates an uncontrollable emotion or feeling; 'can’t help but', 'overwhelmingly'.

points.title: ～でばかりはいられない (〜de bakari wa irarenai)
points.meaning: Cannot afford to only do something; cannot always rely on it.

points.title: ～ではないか (〜de wa nai ka)
points.meaning: Used to show a strong assertion or emphasis on one’s opinion; 'isn't it?', 'aren't you?', 'right?'.

points.title: ～てはならない (〜te wa naranai)
points.meaning: Express prohibition; 'must not', 'cannot', 'should not'.

points.title: ～てまで (〜te made)
points.meaning: Express the extent someone goes in order to achieve something; 'to the point of', 'even', 'so far as to'.

points.title: ～て当然だ (〜te tōzen da)
points.meaning: Expresses that something is natural or expected.

points.title: ～というものだ (〜to iu mono da)
points.meaning: Expressing a general rule or common sense.

points.title: どうにか～ないものか (dō ni ka ~ nai mono ka)
points.romaji: dō ni ka ~ nai mono ka
points.meaning: Express a strong desire or wish for something to be possible.

points.title: ～とおり (〜toori)
points.meaning: Express doing something as instructed or describing how something matches a rule or guideline; 'as', 'according to'.

points.title: ～とか (〜to ka)
points.meaning: Used to list examples or express uncertainty; 'such as', 'like', 'or something like that'.

points.title: ～ところ (〜tokoro)
points.meaning: Express a specific point in time or state; 'when', 'just about', or 'in the middle of'.

points.title: ～どころか (〜dokoro ka)
points.meaning: Express 'far from', 'not just', 'not only', or 'to say nothing of'.

points.title: ～どころではない (〜dokoro de wa nai)
points.meaning: Not the time/place for; far from; can't possibly.

points.title: ～としたら (〜to shitara)
points.meaning: Express a hypothetical situation; 'if', 'suppose', 'assuming'.

points.title: ～としても (〜to shite mo)
points.meaning: Even if, despite, although

points.title: ～と～ともに (〜to 〜tomoni)
points.meaning: Expresses 'together with' or 'along with'; used to describe two events or actions happening simultaneously or in parallel.

points.title: ～とは限らない (〜to wa kagiranai)
points.meaning: Expresses that something is not necessarily true; 'not always', 'not necessarily'.

points.title: ～ないことはない (〜nai koto wa nai)
points.meaning: Express that something is not impossible, meaning it is possible or could be done.

points.title: ～ないこともない (〜nai koto mo nai)
points.meaning: Used to express an action or state is 'not impossible', but emphasizes reluctance or doubt.

points.title: ～ないではいられない (〜nai de wa irarenai)
points.meaning: Cannot help but; cannot avoid; unable to refrain from.

points.title: ～ながら (〜nagara)
points.meaning: Express doing two things simultaneously or at the same time.

points.title: ～にあたり (〜ni atari)
points.meaning: Expresses the meaning of 'at the time of', 'in', 'on', or 'upon'.

points.title: ～において (〜ni oite)
points.meaning: Indicates the place, time, or context where an action or event occurs; 'in', 'at', 'on', 'regarding'.

points.title: ～にかかわらず (〜ni kakawarazu)
points.meaning: Regardless of; irrespective of; (often used as) 'whether or not'.

points.title: ～にかけては (〜ni kakete wa)
points.meaning: Indicates a specific area or aspect in which someone or something excels.

points.title: ～にしたがって (〜ni shitagatte)
points.meaning: Expresses a natural consequence or a change that occurs according to something else; 'as', 'with', 'in accordance with'.

points.title: ～にしたら (〜ni shitara)
points.meaning: Express a point of view; 'from the perspective of', 'if I were'.

points.title: ～にしろ～にしろ (〜ni shiro 〜ni shiro)
points.meaning: Expresses 'either way', 'in any case', 'be it...', used when presenting two alternatives.

points.title: ～につけ～につけ (〜ni tsuke 〜ni tsuke)
points.meaning: Expresses 'whenever', 'each time', 'whether...or'.

points.title: ～につれて (〜ni tsurete)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea that as one thing changes, so does another; 'as', 'along with', 'while'.

points.title: ～にともなって (〜ni tomonatte)
points.meaning: Expresses 'along with' or 'as a result of'; indicates that one event occurs along with another.

points.title: ～にほかならない (〜ni hoka naranai)
points.meaning: Express that something is 'nothing but' or 'none other than'.

points.title: ～にもかかわらず (〜ni mo kakawarazu)
points.meaning: Expresses 'despite', 'in spite of' or 'even though'.

points.title: ～により (〜ni yori)
points.meaning: Indicates the reason, method, or means by which something happens; 'by', 'through', 'due to'.

points.title: ～にわたって (〜ni watatte)
points.meaning: Indicates a range or extent; 'over', 'throughout', 'across'.

points.title: ～に先立ち (〜ni sakidachi)
points.meaning: Express an action or event that occurs before another; 'before', 'prior to', 'preceding'.

points.title: ～に反して (〜ni hanshite)
points.meaning: Contrary to, against, in spite of

points.title: ～に基づいて (〜ni motozuite)
points.meaning: Based on, according to, depending on

points.title: ～に対して (〜ni taishite)
points.meaning: Expresses 'toward', 'against', 'in contrast to', or 'in response to'.

points.title: ～に応えて (〜ni kotaete)
points.meaning: Responding to; living up to; meeting.

points.title: ～に応じて (〜ni oujite)
points.meaning: In accordance with, depending on, in response to.

points.title: ～に決まっている (〜ni kimatte iru)
points.meaning: Express certainty; 'it is obvious', 'it must be', 'no doubt'.

points.title: ～に沿って (〜ni sotte)
points.meaning: Along with; in accordance with; following

points.title: ～に過ぎない (〜ni suginai)
points.meaning: Expresses that something is 'just' or 'nothing more than'; 'merely', 'only', 'simply'.

points.title: ～に関わって (〜ni kakawatte)
points.meaning: Indicates that something is related to or influenced by a certain matter or factor; 'concerning', 'in connection with', 'regarding'.

points.title: ～に限り (〜ni kagiri)
points.meaning: Expresses limitation; 'only', 'limited to', 'exclusive to'.

points.title: ～に際して (〜ni saishite)
points.meaning: Used to express the moment or the occasion of an action; 'at the time of', 'upon', 'when'.

points.title: ～ねばならない (〜neba naranai)
points.meaning: Expresses obligation or necessity; 'must', 'have to', 'need to'.

points.title: ～のみならず～も (〜nomi narazu 〜mo)
points.meaning: Not only... but also; as well as.

points.title: ～のももっともだ (〜no mo mottomo da)
points.meaning: Express that something is understandable or reasonable.

points.title: 〜の上では (〜no ue de wa)
points.meaning: Indicates 'on the basis of', 'in terms of', or 'from the standpoint of'.

points.title: ～の下で (〜no shita de)
points.meaning: Under the context or condition of; under.

points.title: ～ばかりか〜も (〜bakari ka 〜 mo)
points.meaning: Expresses 'not only... but also'; emphasizing the extent of something.

points.title: ～ばかりだ (〜bakari da)
points.meaning: Express a continuing state or negative tendency; 'just', 'only', 'always'.

points.title: ～ばかりに (〜bakari ni)
points.meaning: Express an undesired situation or result caused by something; 'simply because', 'due to', 'on account of'.

points.title: ～ば～というものでもない (〜ba 〜to iu mono demo nai)
points.meaning: Not necessarily true that if A, then B.

points.title: ～はともかく～は (〜wa tomokaku 〜wa)
points.meaning: Used to compare or contrast two elements; 'as for...'.

points.title: ～はまだしも (〜wa mada shimo)
points.meaning: Expresses that while the first item is somewhat acceptable, the second item is not.

points.title: ～はもとより (〜wa moto yori)
points.meaning: Expressing that something is obvious, and there is also something else.

points.title: ～は抜きにして (〜wa nuki ni shite)
points.meaning: Leaving aside, excluding.

points.title: ～べきではない (〜beki dewa nai)
points.meaning: Express that an action should not be done; 'should not', 'ought not to'.

points.title: ～まい (〜mai)
points.meaning: Express a negative conjecture or determination; 'probably not' or 'I will not'.

points.title: ～まで～て (〜made 〜te)
points.meaning: Express doing something until a certain time or condition; 'until', 'to'.

points.title: ～ままに (〜mama ni)
points.meaning: Act according to; leave as is; unchanged.

points.title: ～もかまわず (〜mo kamawazu)
points.meaning: Express indifference or disregard; 'without hesitating', 'without worrying about'.

points.title: ～ものか (〜mono ka)
points.meaning: Definitely not; no way; no chance.

points.title: ～ものがある (〜mono ga aru)
points.meaning: Express a strong impression or feeling; 'there's something about it that...'

points.title: ～ものだ (〜mono da)
points.meaning: Expresses something natural or expected; 'it is normal that...', 'should', 'ought to'.

points.title: ～ものだから (〜mono dakara)
points.meaning: Express the reason or cause for something; 'because', 'since', 'due to'.

points.title: ～ものではない (〜mono dewa nai)
points.meaning: Expresses a strong negative suggestion or prohibition: 'should not', 'must not'.

points.title: ～ものなら (〜mono nara)
points.meaning: Expresses a conditional wish or unlikely possibility; 'if only', 'if it were possible'.

points.title: ～ものの、～ (〜mono no、～)
points.meaning: Indicates contrast or contradiction between two clauses; 'although', 'but'.

points.title: ～も～ば～も～ (〜mo〜ba〜mo〜)
points.meaning: Lists multiple attributes or actions applying to the same subject: 'both…and…', 'not only…but also…'.

points.title: ～も同然だ (〜mo douzen da)
points.meaning: Indicates 'as good as', 'virtually', or 'practically' the same as something.

points.title: ～やら～やら (〜yara〜yara)
points.meaning: Expresses various items or actions, 'things like..., and so on'.

points.title: ～ようがない (〜you ga nai)
points.meaning: Expresses that there is no way (method) to do something; it's impossible to do.

points.title: ～よりほかない (〜yori hoka nai)
points.meaning: Express that there is no other choice; 'have no choice but', 'cannot do anything but'.

points.title: ～わけがない (〜wake ga nai)
points.meaning: Expresses 'there’s no way' or 'it’s impossible', indicating a high degree of certainty.

points.title: ～わけだ (〜wake da)
points.meaning: Express a logical conclusion or reason; 'it means', 'no wonder', 'the reason is'.

points.title: ～わけではない (〜wake dewa nai)
points.meaning: Not necessarily; it doesn't mean that ~.

points.title: ～わけにはいかない (〜wake ni wa ikanai)
points.meaning: Expresses that one cannot (or must not) do something due to responsibility, social pressure, etc.

points.title: ～をきっかけに (〜wo kikkake ni)
points.meaning: Indicates that something serves as a trigger or starting point for another action/event.

points.title: ～を～として (〜wo〜toshite)
points.meaning: Express 'as', 'in the capacity of', or 'taking something as...'.

points.title: ～を中心に (〜wo chuushin ni)
points.meaning: Indicates that something is centered around or focused on a main topic or area.

points.title: ～を問わず (〜wo towazu)
points.meaning: Means 'regardless of' or 'irrespective of'.

points.title: ～を込めて (〜wo komete)
points.meaning: To express that something is done with a certain feeling, intention, or emotion.

points.title: ～を通じて (〜wo tsuujite)
points.meaning: Expresses 'through', 'throughout', or 'during'.

points.title: ～を頼りに (〜wo tayori ni)
points.meaning: To rely on or depend on something or someone.

points.title: ～一方 (〜ippou)
points.meaning: Indicates that while one action or situation is happening, another action or situation is also occurring or is in contrast.

points.title: ～一方だ (〜ippou da)
points.meaning: Expresses that a situation or condition is continuing to increase or decrease in one direction.

points.title: ～上で (〜ue de)
points.meaning: Used to express that something is done after or on the basis of something else; 'after', 'upon'.

points.title: ～上に (〜ue ni)
points.meaning: Express 'in addition to', 'besides', 'not only... but also'.

points.title: ～上は (～ue wa)
points.meaning: Expresses 'now that', 'since', or 'once'.

points.title: ～以上 (〜ijou)
points.meaning: Expresses 'since' or 'as long as' in a conditional context.

points.title: ～以来 (〜irai)
points.meaning: Indicates something happening 'since', 'ever since', or 'after' a particular time.

points.title: ～切る (〜kiru)
points.meaning: To do something completely or thoroughly.

points.title: ～反面 (〜hanmen)
points.meaning: Express contrast between two aspects; 'on the one hand', 'on the other hand'.

points.title: ～向け (〜muke)
points.meaning: Indicating target or intended audience.

points.title: ～恐れがある (〜osore ga aru)
points.meaning: Express a concern or fear that something undesirable might occur.

points.title: ～折には (〜ori ni wa)
points.meaning: Expresses 'when' or 'in case of' specific situations or timings.

points.title: ～末 (～sue)
points.meaning: Express the outcome after a period of time or series of actions; 'after', 'as a result of'.

points.title: ～次第 (〜shidai)
points.meaning: Expresses 'as soon as' (when used with Verb-ますstem) or 'depending on' (when used with a noun).

points.title: ～次第で (〜shidai de)
points.meaning: Indicates 'depending on; based on' a certain factor or situation.

points.title: ～次第です (〜shidai desu)
points.meaning: A polite/formal way to say 'it depends on...' or 'as soon as...', often used in concluding statements.

points.title: ～気味 (〜gimi)
points.meaning: Indicates a slight feeling or tendency toward a particular state.

points.title: ～限り (〜kagiri)
points.meaning: Expresses 'as long as', 'while', or 'to the extent that' a certain condition holds true.

points.title: ～際に (〜sai ni)
points.meaning: Means 'when', 'while', or 'on the occasion of' a certain event or situation.

points.title: A うが B うが (A uga B uga)
points.pattern: A うが B うが
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of 'no matter how... or', 'even if... or'.

points.title: A うと B うと (A uto B uto)
points.pattern: A うと B うと
points.meaning: Shows that the speaker is indifferent to both conditions; 'whether A or B'.

points.title: A かたわら B (A katawara B)
points.meaning: Expresses 'while also', 'at the same time as'.

points.title: A かれ B かれ (A kare B kare)
points.pattern: A かれ B かれ
points.meaning: Expresses 'whether A or B'; both situations are included.

points.title: A だの B だの (A dano B dano)
points.pattern: A だの B だの
points.meaning: Used to list examples (often with a critical or complaining tone); 'things like A, B, etc.'.

points.title: A であれ B であれ (A deare B deare)
points.pattern: A であれ B であれ
points.meaning: Indicates the same statement applies to both A and B; 'whether A or B'.

points.title: A というか B というか (A to iu ka B to iu ka)
points.pattern: A というか B というか
points.romaji: A to iu ka B to iu ka
points.meaning: Means 'rather than say A, it's more like B', or 'whether to call it A or B'.

points.title: A とも B とも (A tomo B tomo)
points.pattern: A とも B とも
points.meaning: Expresses two possibilities; 'either A or B', 'whether A or B'.

points.title: A にしろ B にしろ (A nishiro B nishiro)
points.pattern: A にしろ B にしろ
points.meaning: Means 'whether it is A or B'; 'regardless of A or B'.

points.title: A にせよ B にせよ (A ni seyo B ni seyo)
points.pattern: A にせよ B にせよ
points.romaji: A ni seyo B ni seyo
points.meaning: Either A or B; Regardless of whether it's A or B.

points.title: A につけ B につけ (A ni tsuke B ni tsuke)
points.pattern: A につけ B につけ
points.romaji: A ni tsuke B ni tsuke
points.meaning: Expresses 'whether... or...', 'both... and...', 'in either case'.

points.title: A のやら B のやら (A no yara B no yara)
points.pattern: A のやら B のやら
points.romaji: A no yara B no yara
points.meaning: Used when the speaker is unsure or confused between multiple possibilities.

points.title: Noun1 が Noun1 なら、 Noun2 も Noun2 だ (A ga A nara, B mo B da)
points.pattern: Noun1 が Noun1 なら、 Noun2 も Noun2 だ
points.romaji: A ga A nara, B mo B da
points.meaning: Indicates a parallel or matching situation; 'if Noun1 is (truly) Noun1, then Noun2 is also Noun2'.

points.title: Noun1 も Noun1 なら、Noun2 も Noun2 だ (A mo A nara, B mo B da)
points.pattern: Noun1 も Noun1 なら、Noun2 も Noun2 だ
points.romaji: A mo A nara, B mo B da
points.meaning: Highlights two parallel facts or characteristics; 'if it’s said that ~, then it can also be said that ~'.

points.title: Noun + あっての + Noun (A atte no B)
points.meaning: Expresses 'B cannot exist without A'; 'B only exists because of A'.

points.title: Noun かたがた (Noun kata gata)
points.meaning: Do one thing while also doing another; 'while', 'and at the same time'.

points.title: Noun がてら (Noun gatera)
points.meaning: Means 'while...at the same time', 'on the occasion of', or 'along with'.

points.title: Noun からある (〜kara aru)
points.meaning: Used with large numbers or measurements to emphasize 'at least that many' or 'no less than.'

points.title: Noun からする (Noun kara suru)
points.meaning: Used to indicate that something is judged, estimated, or considered from a certain point or aspect.

points.title: Noun からの (~kara no)
points.meaning: Defines the starting point or the origin; 'from'.

points.title: Noun から言わせれば (~kara iwasereba)
points.meaning: Express the perspective of the noun; 'from ~'s point of view.'

points.title: Noun + ぐるみ (〜gurumi)
points.meaning: Describes 'entirely', 'all together', or 'as a whole group'.

points.title: Noun こそあれ (~koso are)
points.meaning: Expresses 'though there is ... (some negative or burdensome aspect), still ...'.

points.title: Noun こそ～が (~koso~ga)
points.meaning: Emphasizes that 'it is precisely Noun that ...', then adds a contrasting or additional point.

points.title: Noun こそすれ (~koso sure)
points.meaning: An emphatic pattern meaning 'it may be X, but definitely not Y.' Often pairs with a negative statement.

points.title: Noun ごとき / Noun ごとく (〜gotoki/〜gotoku)
points.pattern: Noun ごとき / Noun ごとく
points.meaning: Means 'like a...', 'as if...', expressing a simile or metaphor.

points.title: Noun じゃあるまいし (~ja aru mai shi)
points.meaning: Expressing that something 'is not'; 'it's not like...'. Colloquial/masculine form of ではあるまいし.

points.title: Noun ずくめ (~zukume)
points.meaning: Denotes 'entirely' or 'nothing but' the preceding noun.

points.title: Noun だけではすまない (Noun dake dewa sumanai)
points.pattern: Noun だけではすまない
points.meaning: Expresses 'it can't be settled with just...', 'cannot be resolved merely by...'.

points.title: Noun たりとも～ない (~tari tomo ~nai)
points.meaning: Used to show a strong negative: 'not even ~', 'not a single ~'.

points.title: Noun たる Noun (~taru~)
points.meaning: Indicates 'being in the position/state of', used for roles or statuses.

points.title: Noun ですら (~desura)
points.meaning: Means 'even', 'as much as', used for emphasis in formal contexts.

points.title: Noun でなくてなんだろう (〜de nakute nandarou)
points.pattern: Noun でなくてなんだろう
points.meaning: A strong rhetorical question: 'If not X, then what is it?'

points.title: Noun ではあるまいし (~dewa aru maishi)
points.meaning: Means 'it’s not as if...', 'it’s not that...', more formal than じゃあるまいし.

points.title: Noun と Noun を兼ねて (Noun to Noun o kanete)
points.pattern: Noun と Noun を兼ねて
points.meaning: Used to indicate doing two things at once or fulfilling two roles/purposes.

points.title: Noun といい Noun といい (〜to ii〜to ii)
points.pattern: Noun といい Noun といい
points.meaning: Used to express 'both A and B'; 'whether it's A or B'; 'not to mention A and also B'.

points.title: Noun という Noun (~to iu~)
points.meaning: Used to specify or define one noun with another; 'the noun called', 'the noun that is', or 'a certain'.

points.title: Noun というところだ (Noun to iu tokoro da)
points.meaning: Means 'it's approximately...' or 'it's about...'. Used to show approximation or a general assessment.

points.title: Noun + というもの (~ to iu mono)
points.meaning: Used to express a generic concept: 'all ~', 'any ~ of that kind'.

points.title: Noun といったところだ (Noun to itta tokoro da)
points.pattern: Noun といったところだ
points.meaning: Expresses 'at most', 'as much as', or 'limited to'.

points.title: Noun といわず Noun といわず (A to iwazu B to iwazu)
points.pattern: Noun といわず Noun といわず
points.romaji: A to iwazu B to iwazu
points.meaning: Expresses 'both A and B' or 'be it A or B'; applies to both without distinction.

points.title: Noun + ときたら (〜tokitara)
points.meaning: Expresses strong feelings about a topic; 'speaking of', 'when it comes to'.

points.title: Noun とは比べものにならない (~to wa kurabemono ni naranai)
points.pattern: Noun とは比べものにならない
points.meaning: Indicates something is not comparable; 'beyond comparison'.

points.title: Noun + ともあろう + Noun (~tomoarou~)
points.meaning: Used to criticize or question unbecoming behavior by someone of a certain status.

points.title: Noun ともなると (〜to mo naru to)
points.meaning: 'When it comes to...', emphasizes a change of situation or status.

points.title: Noun ともなれば (〜to mo nareba)
points.meaning: Expresses 'if it comes to', 'when', or 'once'.

points.title: Noun と相まって (~ to aimatte)
points.meaning: Used to express 'in combination with', 'together with', 'along with'.

points.title: Noun なくして～はない (Noun nakushite ~ wa nai)
points.meaning: Expresses 'without ~, there can't be ~'; 'can't do ~ without first doing ~'.

points.title: Noun なしでは～ない (Noun nashi de wa ~nai)
points.meaning: Expresses the necessity of something; 'cannot do without', 'not possible without'.

points.title: Noun なしには～ない (Noun nashi ni wa ~nai)
points.meaning: Means 'without', 'cannot do without', 'not possible without'.

points.title: Noun ならいざ知らず (~nara izashirazu)
points.meaning: Expresses 'maybe X is possible, but Y is definitely not'. Often 'let alone...'.

points.title: Noun + ならでは (~nara de wa)
points.meaning: Expresses something unique or characteristic only of that noun; 'only found in', 'only possible with'.

points.title: Noun なり Noun なり (A nari B nari)
points.pattern: Noun なり Noun なり
points.meaning: Lists alternatives of the same kind; 'either A or B', 'A or B, for example'.

points.title: Noun なりとも (~nari tomo)
points.meaning: Indicates even a small amount or degree; 'at least', 'even a little'.

points.title: Noun に Noun を重ねて (A ni B wo kasanete)
points.pattern: Noun に Noun を重ねて
points.meaning: This expression is used to describe repeated actions or states, 'one after another' or 'pile up'.

points.title: Noun にあっては (Noun ni atte ha)
points.meaning: Indicates a specific situation or environment in which something happens or is the case.

points.title: Noun にあるまじき Noun (Noun ni aru majiki Noun)
points.pattern: Noun にあるまじき Noun
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of 'unfitting', 'unbecoming' or 'inappropriate'.

points.title: Noun にして (Noun ni shite)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea 'even for', 'even though', or 'in spite of'.

points.title: Noun にして初めて (Noun nishite hajimete)
points.meaning: Expresses 'only when/after... for the first time'.

points.title: Noun にすら (〜ni sura)
points.meaning: Expresses the concept of 'even'; 'even in', 'even as', 'even to'.

points.title: Noun にとどまらず～も (~ ni todomarazu ~ mo)
points.meaning: This expresses the idea of 'not only...but also', 'not stopping at...'.

points.title: Noun にひきかえ Noun は (~ni hikikae ~ wa)
points.pattern: Noun にひきかえ Noun は
points.meaning: Represents 'in contrast to', 'as opposed to'.

points.title: Noun にもまして (〜ni mo mashite)
points.meaning: This expresses 'Even more than; exceeding'.

points.title: Noun によらず (～ni yorazu)
points.meaning: Regardless of, irrespective of.

points.title: Noun に先駆けて (〜ni saki gakete)
points.meaning: Meaning 'ahead of', 'before', or 'preceding in time'.

points.title: Noun に即した Noun (A ni sokushita B)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of 'in accordance with', 'based on'.

points.title: Noun に即して Verb (〜ni soku shite ~)
points.meaning: The grammar point Noun に即して Verb is used to mean 'to act in accordance with', 'in line with' or 'based on'.

points.title: Noun に言わせれば (Noun ni iwasereba)
points.meaning: Expresses 'according to', 'if you ask', 'in the opinion of'.

points.title: Noun に限ったことではない (〜ni kagitta koto dewa nai)
points.pattern: Noun に限ったことではない
points.meaning: Indicates that something is not only limited to; 'not only', 'not just'.

points.title: Noun に限ったことでもない (~ni kagitta koto demo nai)
points.pattern: Noun に限ったことでもない
points.meaning: 'Not limited to'; 'not just', 'not exclusively'.

points.title: Noun に限る (~ni kagiru)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea that 'nothing but', 'nothing is better than'.

points.title: Noun ぬいた Noun (A nuita B)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of 'taking something out from something else'.

points.title: Noun + ぬいて（~nuite)
points.meaning: This is a way to express 'minus' or 'except for' some specific noun.

points.title: ～ぬく (~nuku)
points.meaning: Expresses the concept of doing something completely or thoroughly.

points.title: Noun+のいかんだ (Noun no ikan da)
points.meaning: Depends on; up to

points.title: Noun のいかんでは (Noun no ikan de wa)
points.meaning: It depends on the Noun

points.title: Noun のいかんにかかわらず (Noun no ikan ni kakawarazu)
points.pattern: Noun のいかんにかかわらず
points.meaning: Regardless of, irrespective of.

points.title: Noun のいかんによっては (Noun no ikan ni yotte wa)
points.pattern: Noun のいかんによっては
points.romaji: Noun no ikan ni yotte wa
points.meaning: Depending on the matter; depending on noun

points.title: Noun のいかんによらず (~ no ikan ni yorazu)
points.pattern: Noun のいかんによらず
points.meaning: Means 'regardless of', 'irrespective of', or 'no matter'

points.title: Noun のごとき Noun (A no gotoki B)
points.meaning: Expresses 'like' or 'as if'; something/someone resembles something else strongly.

points.title: Noun のことだから (〜no koto dakara)
points.meaning: Because it is about ~, considering it's ~

points.title: Noun の 嫌いがある (Noun no kirai ga aru)
points.pattern: Noun の 嫌いがある
points.meaning: Have a dislike for a particular Noun

points.title: Noun の手前 (~no temae)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of 'Before doing something; on the verge of'.

points.title: Noun の極み (〜no kiwami)
points.meaning: Used to express the extreme or utmost point of something.

points.title: Noun の 至り (~no itari)
points.meaning: Expresses 'the height of', 'the extreme of' something.

points.title: Noun はいざ知らず (~ wa iza shirazu)
points.meaning: ‘I can understand it for ~, but for …? (surprising)’

points.title: Noun はおろか～すら (Noun wa oroka ～sura)
points.meaning: Expresses 'not to mention ~, even ~'.

points.title: Noun はおろか～まで (~wa oroka ~made)
points.meaning: Means 'not just A, but even B'; 'let alone A, even B'.

points.title: Noun はおろか～も (Noun wa oroka ～ mo)
points.meaning: 'Not only...but also', 'not to mention', 'to say nothing of'

points.title: Noun はさておき (~ wa sateoki)
points.meaning: Means 'putting aside', 'aside from', 'notwithstanding'.

points.title: Noun + はどうであれ (~ wa dou de are)
points.meaning: This phrase means 'regardless of' or 'no matter how…'.

points.title: Noun まみれ (~mamire)
points.meaning: Expresses a state in which something is entirely covered or filled with something else.

points.title: Noun もさることながら Noun も (A mo saru koto nagara B mo)
points.pattern: Noun もさることながら Noun も
points.romaji: A mo saru koto nagara B mo
points.meaning: Means 'not only... but also'; the second noun is especially emphasized.

points.title: Noun も兼ねて (~mo kanete)
points.meaning: Used to express 'as well as', 'also', or 'at the same time'.

points.title: Noun も相まって (~mo aimatte)
points.meaning: Used to express that combined with something else, it caused a certain outcome.

points.title: Noun を おいて他に Verb ない (〜wo oite hoka ni〜nai)
points.pattern: Noun を おいて他に Verb ない
points.meaning: Means 'apart from ~ there's nothing else,' implying the Noun is the best or most suitable choice.

points.title: Noun をもって (~wo motte)
points.meaning: Used to indicate means, methods, or time; 'with', 'by means of', 'at'.

points.title: Noun をものともせずに (Noun wo mono tomo sezu ni)
points.pattern: Noun をものともせずに
points.romaji: Noun wo mono tomo sezu ni
points.meaning: Expresses the idea that 'despite something, action was carried out', translating to 'without being fazed by something'.

points.title: Noun をよそに (~wo yoso ni)
points.meaning: Despite; Notwithstanding; Regardless of

points.title: Noun を余儀なくされる (Noun wo yogi naku sareru)
points.pattern: Noun を余儀なくされる
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of being forced into a certain situation, 'to be compelled', 'to be obliged'.

points.title: Noun を前提として (Noun wo zentei toshite)
points.meaning: Used to express 'on the assumption of', 'based on'.

points.title: Noun を前提にして (Noun wo zentei ni shite)
points.meaning: Assuming; presupposing; on the assumption of.

points.title: Noun を境にして (Noun wo sakai ni shite)
points.meaning: Means 'as a turning point', 'since (time)', or 'from (time) on'.

points.title: Noun を機にして (~wo ki ni shite)
points.meaning: To take the opportunity to; taking the occasion to; on the occasion of.

points.title: Noun を皮切りに / を皮切りにして (Noun wo kawakiri ni / wo kawakiri ni shite)
points.pattern: Noun を皮切りに / を皮切りにして
points.romaji: Noun wo kawakiri ni / wo kawakiri ni shite
points.meaning: Used to indicate the starting point of some series of events or actions; 'starting with', 'beginning with'.

points.title: Noun を皮切りにして (Noun wo kawakiri ni shite)
points.meaning: Used to express 'Starting with', 'Beginning with'

points.title: Noun を禁じ得ない (〜wo kinjienai)
points.meaning: 'Cannot help but do', or 'inevitable'

points.title: Noun を経て (〜wo hete)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of 'through' or 'via'; going through some process or phase.

points.title: Noun を踏まえて (〜wo fumaete)
points.meaning: Based on; taking into account; in light of

points.title: Noun を限りに (Noun wo kagiri ni)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of 'as of', 'with', or 'from', indicating the end of something or a point of change.

points.title: Noun 並み (~nami)
points.meaning: Indicates 'like' or 'as' something or someone; 'equivalent to', 'around'.

points.title: Noun + 前提で (Noun + zentei de)
points.meaning: Expresses a condition or requirement for something to be established: 'on the assumption that', 'under the condition of'.

points.title: Verbる / Noun(である) + 限り(は) (kagiri (wa))
points.pattern: Verbる / Noun(である) + 限り(は) (kagiri (wa))
points.meaning: Expresses 'as long as', 'while this condition is true'.

points.title: Verb がてら (~ gatera)
points.meaning: Expresses doing something while doing another; 'while', 'on the occasion of'.

points.title: Verb こそすれ (~koso sure)
points.meaning: Often used in the pattern 'Xこそすれ、Y〜ない', meaning 'One might do X, but definitely not Y'.

points.title: Verb させられる (~saserareru)
points.meaning: Expresses 'being forced to do something' or 'being made to do something'.

points.title: Verb ざるを得ない (~ zaru wo enai)
points.meaning: 'Cannot but', 'have no choice but to', 'forced to'

points.title: Verb ずじまい (~zu jimai)
points.meaning: Expressing regret for not having done something; not being able to; missing the chance to do it.

points.title: Verb ずとも (〜zu tomo)
points.meaning: Means 'Even without doing (X), (Y) can still happen'.

points.title: Verb ずにはおかない (~zuni wa okanai)
points.meaning: Expresses 'cannot help but...', 'will definitely...', or 'must do something'.

points.title: Verb ずにはすまない (Verb zuni wa sumanai)
points.meaning: 'Cannot do without...', 'unavoidable', 'have to'.

points.title: Verb そうにない (Verb sou ni nai)
points.meaning: Expresses unlikelihood or that something does not seem likely to happen.

points.title: Verb そうもない (〜sou mo nai)
points.meaning: Expresses negative potential; 'it doesn't seem like...', 'it's not likely...'.

points.title: Verb そばから (〜soba kara)
points.meaning: Expresses that as soon as one action finishes, another begins immediately.

points.title: Verb たが最後 (〜ta ga saigo)
points.meaning: Emphasizes 'once something happens, there is no going back'; 'once', 'as soon as', etc.

points.title: Verb たことにしてください (~ ta koto ni shite kudasai)
points.pattern: Verb たことにしてください
points.meaning: Asking someone to pretend or accept that something has already happened or taken a certain state.

points.title: Verb たら Verb たで (~ tara ~ tade)
points.pattern: Verb たら Verb たで
points.meaning: Conveys that if something happens (or doesn’t happen), there is a particular consequence or situation either way.

points.title: Verb たら きりがない (Verb tara kiri ga nai)
points.pattern: Verb たら きりがない
points.meaning: Indicates an endless or unending cycle once an action is started; 'if one starts doing something, it will not stop.'

points.title: Verb たら最後 (〜tara saigo)
points.meaning: Expresses that once a certain action happens, the situation changes irreversibly—usually in a negative way.

points.title: Verb つ Verb つ (Verb tsu Verb tsu)
points.meaning: Expresses two alternating actions happening repeatedly.

points.title: Verb てからというもの (Verb te kara to iu mono)
points.pattern: Verb てからというもの
points.romaji: Verb te kara to iu mono
points.meaning: Expresses that ever since a certain event happened, a condition has continued until now.

points.title: Verb てこそ (Verb te koso)
points.meaning: Emphasizes 'only by doing something, a certain result or realization can occur.'

points.title: Verb ては (～te wa)
points.meaning: Expresses a repeated pattern or cycle, often implying a frustrating outcome; 'whenever X happens, Y happens again.'

points.title: Verb ては Verb (~ te wa ~)
points.meaning: Expresses a repeated pattern of action; translates as 'every time', 'whenever', etc.

points.title: Verb てまでも (~ temademo)
points.meaning: Expresses 'even if it means doing...', 'no matter what it takes'.

points.title: Verb てみせる (Verb te miseru)
points.meaning: 'Show by doing', 'demonstrate', 'prove by action'.

points.title: Verb てやまない (Verb te yamanai)
points.meaning: Used with certain emotional/mental verbs to show a strong, unceasing emotion: 'can't stop', 'never cease to'.

points.title: Verb ないではおかない (~ nai de wa okanai)
points.pattern: Verb ないではおかない
points.meaning: Means 'cannot help but do', 'will definitely do', or 'is bound to happen'.

points.title: Verb ないではすまない (Verb nai dewa sumanai)
points.pattern: Verb ないではすまない
points.meaning: 'Cannot end without doing', 'must do'—an unavoidable moral or social necessity.

points.title: Verb ないまでも (Verb nai made mo)
points.meaning: 'Even if not to the extent of...', 'although not completely...'.

points.title: Verb ないものだろうか (Verb nai mono darou ka)
points.pattern: Verb ないものだろうか
points.meaning: Expressing hope or wonder if something can be done: 'Isn't there a way...?', 'Can't we...?'

points.title: Verb ないものでもない (Verb nai mono demo nai)
points.pattern: Verb ないものでもない
points.meaning: Expresses the idea that it's not entirely impossible or non-existent: 'It's not that I don't...', 'It's not that there aren't...'

points.title: Verb の ない Noun (~ no nai ~)
points.meaning: Used to modify a noun with a negative verb form; 'a Noun without (Verb)'.

points.title: Verb ば きりがない (〜ba kiri ga nai)
points.pattern: Verb ば きりがない
points.meaning: Indicates there's no end once you start listing, doing, or saying something: 'If one starts to..., there will be no end.'

points.title: Verb もしないで (~ mo shinai de)
points.meaning: Means 'without even doing'.

points.title: Verb やしない (~ yashinai)
points.meaning: Expresses a strong denial or refusal: 'I would never...', 'No way I would...'.

points.title: Verb よう (~ you / ~ you ni)
points.meaning: Expresses 'the way/manner of doing something' or 'in order to / so that / try to'.

points.title: Verb ようか Verbるまいか (Verb you ka Verb ru mai ka)
points.pattern: Verb ようか Verbるまいか
points.romaji: Verb you ka Verb ru mai ka
points.meaning: Expresses indecision: 'Should I do it or not?'.

points.title: Verb ようが Verb るまいが (Verb you ga Verb ru mai ga)
points.pattern: Verb ようが Verb るまいが
points.romaji: Verb you ga Verb ru mai ga
points.meaning: Expresses 'whether or not', 'no matter if something happens or not'.

points.title: Verb ようがない (〜you ga nai)
points.meaning: Expresses 'no way to do something,' 'impossible to do'.

points.title: Verb ようと Verbる まいと (Verb you to Verb ru mai to)
points.pattern: Verb ようと Verbる まいと
points.romaji: Verb you to Verb ru mai to
points.meaning: This structure indicates that regardless of whether one does (verb) or not, the outcome/attitude remains unchanged.

points.title: Verb ようにも (〜you ni mo)
points.meaning: Used to express 'even though one wants to do something, one can't for some reason'.

points.title: Verb ようにも Verb れない (〜you ni mo 〜renai)
points.pattern: Verb ようにも Verb れない
points.meaning: Expresses the inability to do something even if one wants/tries.

points.title: Verb ようもない (~you mo nai)
points.meaning: Expresses 'it's impossible to do something'.

points.title: Verbる がままに (〜ga mama ni)
points.meaning: Expresses 'letting something happen as it is'; 'just as something does'.

points.title: Verbる が早いか (verb-ru ga hayai ka)
points.meaning: Expresses 'as soon as...' or 'the moment when...'.

points.title: Verbる くらいなら (〜ru kurai nara)
points.meaning: Expresses preference to avoid something: 'rather than...', 'if it comes to doing X, I'd rather...'.

points.title: Verbる こと なし に (Verb-ru koto nashi ni)
points.pattern: Verbる こと なし に
points.meaning: Used to express 'without doing something'.

points.title: Verbる ことのないように (Verb-ru koto no nai you ni)
points.pattern: Verbる ことのないように
points.romaji: Verb-ru koto no nai you ni
points.meaning: Expresses the desire or effort to prevent something: 'so as not to...', 'to avoid...'.

points.title: Verbる ときりがない (verb-ru to kiri ga nai)
points.meaning: Used to indicate that something can go on endlessly or without limits.

points.title: Verbる ともなく Verb (Verb-ru tomonaku Verb)
points.meaning: Used to express 'without a particular intention', 'unconsciously', or 'before one knows it'.

points.title: Verbる ともなしに Verb (Verb-ru tomonashi ni Verb)
points.pattern: Verbる ともなしに Verb
points.meaning: Expresses doing something unintentionally or without conscious thought.

points.title: Verbる なり (Verb-ru nari)
points.meaning: Expresses 'as soon as' or 'the moment'.

points.title: Verbる にとどまらず～も (Verb-ru ni todomarazu ~ mo)
points.pattern: Verbる にとどまらず～も
points.meaning: Expresses 'not only… but also', 'not limited to…'.

points.title: Verbる にはあたらない (Verb-ru ni wa ataranai)
points.pattern: Verbる にはあたらない
points.meaning: Used to say 'there is no need to...', 'it’s not necessary to...'.

points.title: Verbる にも (Verb-ru ni mo)
points.meaning: Indicates that doing the verb is impossible or difficult, even if one wants to.

points.title: Verbる にも Verb れない (Verb-ru ni mo Verb-re nai)
points.pattern: Verbる にも Verb れない
points.meaning: Expresses: 'Even if I try/want to do something, I cannot.'

points.title: Verbる べからざる Noun (Verb-ru bekara zaru Noun)
points.pattern: Verbる べからざる Noun
points.meaning: Used to express what should not be done; 'must not', 'should not'.

points.title: Verbる べからず (〜ru bekara zu)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of 'must not do' or 'should not do'.

points.title: Verbる べく (Verb-ru beku)
points.meaning: Expresses the meaning of 'in order to', 'for the purpose of'.

points.title: Verbる べくもない (Verb-ru beku mo nai)
points.meaning: Means 'it's impossible to...' or 'there's no way to...'.

points.title: Verbる までもない (〜ru made mo nai)
points.meaning: It's not necessary to the extent of; no need to.

points.title: Verbる ものとする (〜ru mono to suru)
points.meaning: Assuming or deciding something as...

points.title: Verbる や否や (Verb-ru ya ina ya)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of 'as soon as', 'the moment...'.

points.title: Verbる 始末だ (〜ru shimatsu da)
points.meaning: Indicates a (often unfortunate) result or conclusion of an action.

points.title: Verbる 嫌いがある (～ru kirai ga aru)
points.meaning: Tendency to do a negative action; have a bad habit of ~.

points.title: いつまで～のやら (itsumade ~ no yara)
points.meaning: Expresses uncertainty regarding duration; 'don't know when... will end'.

points.title: ～が Verb られる (〜ga Verb rareru)
points.meaning: Expresses potential or ability to do something; 'can', 'able to'.

points.title: ～かと思いきや (〜ka to omoikiya)
points.meaning: Expressing unexpected outcomes; 'just when I thought...', 'but...'.

points.title: ～がゆえに (～ga yue ni)
points.meaning: Expresses the reason or cause; 'because', 'due to', 'as a result of'.

points.title: ～がゆえの Noun (〜ga yue no Noun)
points.meaning: Expresses the reason or cause for something; 'because of', 'due to'.

points.title: ～から Noun に 至る まで (〜kara 〜ni itaru made)
points.pattern: ～から Noun に 至る まで
points.meaning: Expressing range from one thing to another; 'from...to', 'ranging from...to'.

points.title: ～ごとく (〜gotoku)
points.meaning: To seem like; as if; as though.

points.title: ～こととて (〜koto tote)
points.meaning: Used to express the reason or premise for a decision or judgment; 'since', 'because'.

points.title: ～ずにすんだ (〜zuni sunda)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of 'was able to do without'; 'managed to avoid'.

points.title: ～だろうとなかろうと (〜darou to nakarou to)
points.meaning: Expresses 'regardless of whether it is or isn't'.

points.title: ～つもりだ (〜tsumori da)
points.meaning: Expresses the speaker's intention or plan.

points.title: ～つもりで (〜tsumori de)
points.meaning: Expresses the speaker's intention or plan; 'with the intention of', 'planning to'.

points.title: ～ではすまない (〜dewa sumanai)
points.meaning: Expresses that just doing something is not enough or will not suffice.

points.title: ～とあって (〜to atte)
points.meaning: Expresses a special situation or event due to certain circumstances.

points.title: ～とあれば (〜to areba)
points.meaning: Expresses a condition; 'if', 'when', 'since'.

points.title: ～といえども (〜to iedomo)
points.meaning: Even if it is said that; Even though; Although.

points.title: ～といったらありはしない (〜to ittara ari wa shinai)
points.meaning: Express extreme exclamation; 'extremely', 'unbelievable', 'unsurpassed'.

points.title: ～といったらありゃしない (〜to ittara arya shinai)
points.meaning: Emphasizes that something is to the extreme; 'you have no idea how...', 'it's incredibly...'.

points.title: ～といったらない (〜to ittara nai)
points.meaning: Expresses the extreme of something; 'nothing can be more ... than this'.

points.title: ～ときている (〜to kite iru)
points.meaning: Highlights a situation or condition that is serious/extreme, often with a negative nuance.

points.title: ～ところを (〜tokoro wo)
points.meaning: Indicates a contrasting or inconvenient timing; 'just when...', 'even though...'.

points.title: ～とされる (〜to sareru)
points.meaning: Indicates a general belief or widely accepted view; 'is considered', 'is seen as', 'is said to be'.

points.title: ～としたところで (〜to shita tokoro de)
points.meaning: Means 'even if' or 'even assuming'; emphasizes that the outcome won’t change.

points.title: ～とすると (〜to suru to)
points.meaning: Expresses 'if', 'when', or 'assuming that' in a speculative sense.

points.title: ～とすれば (～to sureba)
points.meaning: Used to express 'if it were the case that...', 'if we assume that...'.

points.title: ～となったら (〜to nattara)
points.meaning: Used to express 'if it comes to...', 'when it becomes the case that...'.

points.title: ～となると (〜to naru to)
points.meaning: Used to highlight a certain circumstance; 'when it comes to...', 'if it becomes...', 'in the event that...'.

points.title: ～となれば (〜to nareba)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea of 'if it comes to...; when we talk about...; in the case of...'.

points.title: ～とのことだ (〜to no koto da)
points.meaning: Expresses something that the speaker heard; 'I've heard that', 'I was told that'.

points.title: ～とはいえ (～to wa ie)
points.meaning: Even though; although; but

points.title: ～とみえて (〜to miete)
points.meaning: It seems that; apparently

points.title: ～とみられる (～to mirareru)
points.meaning: It is considered that; It is thought that; It is believed that

points.title: ～とみると (〜to miru to)
points.meaning: Expresses the concept of 'when one sees it as', 'viewed as', or 'considering'.

points.title: どんなに～うが (donna ni ～ u ga)
points.meaning: Expresses 'no matter how much...', 'even if...'.

points.title: ～と言わんばかりに (〜to iwan bakari ni)
points.meaning: Indicates an action or behavior that strongly implies a certain unspoken message or feeling.

points.title: ～と言わんばかりの Noun (～to iwan bakari no Noun)
points.meaning: Expresses the concept of 'as if to say'; 'almost says'; 'suggests'.

points.title: ～ながらに (～nagara ni)
points.meaning: Expresses a state or condition continuing just as it is (e.g. 'from birth', 'while crying', 'in the old way').

points.title: ～ながらの Noun (〜nagara no Noun)
points.meaning: Indicates one action or state happening at the same time as the noun in question (e.g. 'dinner while watching TV').

points.title: ～ながらも (〜nagara mo)
points.meaning: Means 'even though' or 'despite'.

points.title: ～なくはない (〜naku wa nai)
points.meaning: Expresses the idea 'it's not that it's impossible' or 'it's not that I can't'.

points.title: ～なくもない (〜naku mo nai)
points.meaning: Expresses 'not impossible' or 'might as well'.

points.title: ～なら～なりに
points.meaning: Means 'if it is X, then it's X in its own way', emphasizing unique qualities.

points.title: ～には及ばない (〜ni wa oyobanai)
points.meaning: Means 'no need to go that far' or 'not necessary'.

points.title: ～に堪えない (～ni taenai)
points.meaning: Indicates something is unbearable or not worth doing (e.g., 'unbearable to watch', 'unbearable to listen to').

points.title: ～に堪える (～ni taeru)
points.meaning: Used to say that something is 'worth doing' or 'can stand up to' something (the positive counterpart of ～に堪えない).

points.title: ～に耐える (～ni taeru)
points.meaning: To endure or withstand something; 'endure', 'withstand', 'tolerate'.

points.title: ～に至った (〜ni itatta)
points.meaning: Expresses the outcome or final conclusion of a process; 'reached the point', 'led to'.

points.title: ～に越したことはない (〜ni koshita koto wa nai)
points.meaning: Expresses that something is the best or most desirable course of action; 'nothing better than...'.

points.title: ～に難くない (～ni katakunai)
points.meaning: Expresses 'not difficult to ~' in a formal/literary sense; e.g., 'not hard to imagine/understand'.

points.title: ～のは Noun ぐらいのものだ (〜no wa Noun gurai no mono da)
points.pattern: ～のは Noun ぐらいのものだ
points.romaji: 〜no wa Noun gurai no mono da
points.meaning: Conveys that 'only (Noun) is the case' or 'nothing but (Noun)'.

points.title: ～ば～ものを (～ba～mono o)
points.meaning: Expresses regret or a missed opportunity: 'if only', 'had I but...'.

points.title: ～びた (～bita)
points.meaning: A suffix meaning “looking or seeming like ~” (often appears with nouns/adjectives).

points.title: ～びる (〜biru)
points.meaning: A suffix meaning “to appear/to become ~,” often used with certain adjectives or nouns.

points.title: ～ぶった (～butta)
points.meaning: Often appears as a past form of ～ぶる, meaning 'acted/pretended like ~' (or literally 'hit/bashed', depending on context).

points.title: ～ぶって (〜butte)
points.meaning: Te-form of ～ぶる, meaning 'acting/pretending to be ~'.

points.title: ～ぶり (〜buri)
points.meaning: Expresses the amount of time elapsed since doing something last.

points.title: ～ぶる (〜buru)
points.meaning: Used when someone is acting or pretending to be something they are not (often a negative connotation).

points.title: ～までだ (～made da)
points.meaning: Expresses a limit or extent; 'it's only up to...', 'no more than...'.

points.title: ～もなんでもない (〜mo nandemonai)
points.meaning: Used to dismiss or negate something’s importance; 'it’s nothing at all', 'it doesn’t matter'.

points.title: ～ものとして (～mono to shite)
points.meaning: Indicates an assumption or supposition; 'assuming', 'under the assumption that'.

points.title: ～んがために (〜n ga tame ni)
points.meaning: Emphasizes the reason or purpose for an action; 'in order to', 'for the sake of'.

points.title: ～んばかりに (〜n bakari ni)
points.meaning: Indicates 'as though about to ~' or 'as if to say ~'.

points.title: ～差し支えない (〜sashitsukaenai)
points.meaning: Indicates no problem or obstacle; 'it’s fine if...', 'there’s no issue'.

points.title: ～折に (〜ori ni)
points.meaning: Indicates the time or occasion when something happens; 'when', 'at the time of'.

points.title: ～極まりない (〜kiwamarinai)
points.meaning: Expresses an extreme state, often negative; 'utterly', 'extremely', 'boundlessly'.

points.title: ～極まる (〜kiwamaru)
points.meaning: Also expresses an extreme degree or state, typically negative.

points.title: ～足りない (～tarinai)
points.meaning: Expresses insufficiency or lack; 'not enough', 'insufficient'.

points.title: ～足る Noun (〜taru Noun)
points.meaning: Indicates that something is worthy or sufficient to be called/used as ~; 'worthy of', 'enough to ~'.

points.title: ～限りだ (〜kagiri da)
points.meaning: Expresses an extreme degree of emotion or reaction; 'I feel so ~', 'as ~ as can be'.
